en_us.create.ponder.analog_lever.header: Controlling signals using the Analog Lever
en_us.create.ponder.analog_lever.text_1: Analog Levers make for a compact and precise source of redstone power
en_us.create.ponder.analog_lever.text_2: Right-click to increase its analog power output
en_us.create.ponder.analog_lever.text_3: Right-click while Sneaking to decrease the power output again
en_us.create.ponder.andesite_tunnel.text_1: Andesite Tunnels can be used to cover up your belts
en_us.create.ponder.andesite_tunnel.text_2: Whenever an Andesite Tunnel has connections to the sides...
en_us.create.ponder.andesite_tunnel.text_3: ...they will split exactly one item off of any passing stacks
en_us.create.ponder.andesite_tunnel.text_4: The remainder will continue on its path
en_us.create.ponder.auto_schedule.text_1: Schedules can be used to provide drivers with a destination
en_us.create.ponder.auto_schedule.text_2: Comparators will receive a signal whenever a Train is present
en_us.create.ponder.auto_schedule.text_3: Mind that a Station can only be approached from the indicated direction
en_us.create.ponder.auto_schedule.text_4: Stations can also be used to assign new Schedules automatically
en_us.create.ponder.auto_schedule.text_5: The Schedule placed on a station will automatically copy itself to present trains
en_us.create.ponder.auto_schedule.text_6: As opposed to manual scheduling, drivers will not take the item with them
en_us.create.ponder.basin.text_1: A Basin can hold Items and Fluids for Processing
en_us.create.ponder.basin.text_2: After a processing step, basins try to output below to the side of them
en_us.create.ponder.basin.text_3: When a valid component is present, the Basin will show an output faucet
en_us.create.ponder.basin.text_4: A number of options are applicable here
en_us.create.ponder.basin.text_5: Outputs will be caught by the inventory below
en_us.create.ponder.basin.text_6: Without output faucet, the Basin will retain items created in its processing
en_us.create.ponder.basin.text_7: This can be useful if outputs should be re-used as ingredients
en_us.create.ponder.basin.text_8: Desired outputs will then have to be extracted from the basin
en_us.create.ponder.basin.text_9: A Filter might be necessary to avoid pulling out un-processed items
en_us.create.ponder.bearing_modes.header: Movement Modes of the Mechanical Bearing
en_us.create.ponder.bearing_modes.text_1: When Stopped, the Bearing will place the structure at the nearest grid-aligned Angle
en_us.create.ponder.bearing_modes.text_2: It can be configured never to revert to solid blocks, or only near the angle it started at
en_us.create.ponder.belt_casing.text_1: Brass or Andesite Casing can be used to decorate Mechanical Belts
en_us.create.ponder.belt_casing.text_2: A wrench can be used to remove the casing
en_us.create.ponder.belt_connector.text_1: Right-Clicking two shafts with a belt item will connect them together
en_us.create.ponder.belt_connector.text_2: Accidental selections can be canceled with Right-Click while Sneaking
en_us.create.ponder.belt_connector.text_3: Additional Shafts can be added throughout the Belt
en_us.create.ponder.belt_connector.text_4: Shafts connected via Belts will rotate with Identical Speed and Direction
en_us.create.ponder.belt_connector.text_5: Added shafts can be removed using the wrench
en_us.create.ponder.belt_connector.text_6: Mechanical Belts can be dyed for aesthetic purposes
en_us.create.ponder.belt_directions.text_1: Belts cannot connect in arbitrary directions
en_us.create.ponder.belt_directions.text_5: 4. And they can connect vertical shafts horizontally
en_us.create.ponder.belt_directions.text_6: These are all possible directions. Belts can span any Length between 2 and 20 blocks
en_us.create.ponder.belt_transport.text_1: Moving belts will transport Items and other Entities
en_us.create.ponder.belt_transport.text_2: Right-Click with an empty hand to take items off a belt
en_us.create.ponder.blaze_burner.text_1: Blaze Burners can provide Heat to Items processed in a Basin
en_us.create.ponder.blaze_burner.text_2: For this, the Blaze has to be fed with flammable items
en_us.create.ponder.blaze_burner.text_3: With a Blaze Cake, the Burner can reach an even stronger level of heat
en_us.create.ponder.blaze_burner.text_4: The feeding process can be automated using Deployers or Mechanical Arms
en_us.create.ponder.brass_funnel.text_1: Andesite Funnels can only ever extract single items.
en_us.create.ponder.brass_funnel.text_2: Brass Funnels can extract up to a full stack.
en_us.create.ponder.brass_funnel.text_3: The value panel allows for precise control over the extracted stack size.
en_us.create.ponder.brass_funnel.text_4: Using items on the filter slot will restrict the funnel to only transfer matching stacks.
en_us.create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_1: Brass Tunnels can be used to cover up your belts
en_us.create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_2: Brass Tunnels have filter slots on each open side
en_us.create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_3: Filters on inbound connections simply block non-matching items
en_us.create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_4: Filters on outbound connections can be used to sort items by type
en_us.create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_5: Whenever a passing item has multiple valid exits, the distribution mode will decide how to handle it
en_us.create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_6: Brass Tunnels on parallel belts will form a group
en_us.create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_7: Incoming Items will now be distributed across all connected exits
en_us.create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_8: For this, items can also be inserted into the Tunnel block directly
en_us.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.header: Distribution Modes of the Brass Tunnel
en_us.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_1: The distribution behaviour of Brass Tunnels can be configured
en_us.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_10: 'Synchronize Inputs' is a unique setting for Brass Tunnels
en_us.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_11: Items are only allowed past if every tunnel in the group has one waiting
en_us.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_12: This ensures that all affected belts supply items at the same rate
en_us.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_2: 'Split' will attempt to distribute the stack evenly between available outputs
en_us.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_3: If an output is unable to take more items, it will be skipped
en_us.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_4: 'Forced Split' will never skip outputs, and instead wait until they are free
en_us.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_5: 'Round Robin' keeps stacks whole, and cycles through outputs iteratively
en_us.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_6: Once Again, if an output is unable to take more items, it will be skipped
en_us.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_8: 'Prefer Nearest' prioritizes the outputs closest to the items' input location
en_us.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_9: 'Randomize' will distribute whole stacks to randomly picked outputs
en_us.create.ponder.cart_assembler.text_1: Powered Cart Assemblers mount attached structures to passing Minecarts
en_us.create.ponder.cart_assembler.text_2: Without a redstone signal, it disassembles passing cart contraptions back into blocks
en_us.create.ponder.cart_assembler.text_3: Using a Wrench on the Minecart will let you carry the Contraption elsewhere
en_us.create.ponder.cart_assembler_dual.text_1: Whenever two Cart Assemblers share an attached structure...
en_us.create.ponder.cart_assembler_dual.text_2: Powering either of them will create a Carriage Contraption
en_us.create.ponder.cart_assembler_dual.text_3: The carts will behave like those connected via Minecart Coupling
en_us.create.ponder.cart_assembler_modes.text_: Cart Contraptions will rotate to face towards their carts' motion
This Arrow indicates which side of the Structure will be considered the front
If the Assembler is set to Lock Rotation, the contraptions' orientation will never change
en_us.create.ponder.cart_assembler_rails.heade: Other types of Minecarts and Rails
en_us.create.ponder.cart_assembler_rails.text_: Cart Assemblers on Regular Tracks will not affect the passing carts' motion
When on Powered or Controller Rail, the carts will be held in place until it's Powered
Other types of Minecarts can be used as the anchor
Furnace Carts will keep themselves powered, pulling fuel from any attached inventories
en_us.create.ponder.chain_conveyor.header: Relaying rotational force using Chain Conveyors
en_us.create.ponder.chain_conveyor.text_1: Right-click two conveyors with chains to connect them
en_us.create.ponder.chain_conveyor.text_2: Chain conveyors relay rotational power between each other..
en_us.create.ponder.chain_conveyor.text_3: ..and connect to shafts above or below them
en_us.create.ponder.chain_conveyor.text_4: Right-click holding a wrench to start travelling on the chain
en_us.create.ponder.chain_conveyor.text_5: At a junction, face towards a chain to follow it
en_us.create.ponder.chain_drive.header: Relaying rotational force with Chain Drives
en_us.create.ponder.chain_drive.text_1: Chain Drives relay rotation to each other in a row
en_us.create.ponder.chain_drive.text_2: All shafts connected like this will rotate in the same direction
en_us.create.ponder.chain_drive.text_3: Any part of the row can be rotated by 90 degrees
en_us.create.ponder.chain_gearshift.header: Controlling rotational speed with Chain Gearshifts
en_us.create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_1: Unpowered Chain Gearshifts behave exactly like Chain Drives
en_us.create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_2: When Powered, the speed transmitted to other Chain Drives in the row is doubled
en_us.create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_3: Whenever the Powered Gearshift is not at the source, its speed will be halved instead
en_us.create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_4: In both cases, Chain Drives in the row always run at 2x the speed of the Powered Gearshift
en_us.create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_5: Using analog signals, the ratio can be adjusted more precisely between 1 and 2
en_us.create.ponder.chute.text_1: Chutes can transport items vertically from and to inventories
en_us.create.ponder.chute.text_2: Using the Wrench, a window can be created
en_us.create.ponder.chute.text_3: Using Industrial Iron Blocks, chutes can be encased
en_us.create.ponder.chute.text_4: Placing chutes targeting the side faces of another will make it diagonal
en_us.create.ponder.chute_upward.text_1: Using Encased Fans at the top or bottom, a Chute can move items upward
en_us.create.ponder.chute_upward.text_2: Inspecting chutes with Engineers' Goggles reveals information about the movement direction
en_us.create.ponder.chute_upward.text_3: On the 'blocked' end, items will have to be inserted/taken from the sides
en_us.create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_1: Clockwork Bearings attach to blocks in front of them
en_us.create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_2: Upon receiving Rotational Force, the structure will be rotated according to the hour of the day
en_us.create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_5: Right-Click the bearing to start or stop animating the structure
en_us.create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_6: In front of the Hour Hand, a second structure can be added
en_us.create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_7: Ensure that the two Structures are not glued to each other
en_us.create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_8: The Second Structure will now rotate as the Minute Hand
en_us.create.ponder.clutch.header: Controlling rotational force using a Clutch
en_us.create.ponder.clutch.text_1: Clutches will relay rotation in a straight line
en_us.create.ponder.clutch.text_2: When powered by Redstone, it breaks the connection
en_us.create.ponder.cog_speedup.text_1: Large and Small cogs can be connected diagonally
en_us.create.ponder.cog_speedup.text_2: Shifting from large to small cogs, the conveyed speed will be doubled
en_us.create.ponder.cog_speedup.text_3: Shifting the opposite way, the conveyed speed will be halved
en_us.create.ponder.cogwheel.text_1: Cogwheels will relay rotation to other adjacent cogwheels
en_us.create.ponder.cogwheel.text_2: Neighbouring shafts connected like this will rotate in opposite directions
en_us.create.ponder.cogwheel_casing.text_1: Brass or Andesite Casing can be used to decorate Cogwheels
en_us.create.ponder.cogwheel_casing.text_2: Components added after encasing will not connect to the shaft outputs
en_us.create.ponder.cogwheel_casing.text_3: The Wrench can be used to toggle connections
en_us.create.ponder.contraption_controls.text_: Actors on moving contraptions are always active by default
Contraption Controls can be used to toggle them on the fly
They can be attached anywhere on the contraption
While disassembled, the filter can be changed to target specific types of actors
If it is redstone-activated during assembly...
...targeted actors will be turned off from the start
en_us.create.ponder.creative_fluid_tank.text_1: Creative Fluid Tanks can be used to provide a bottomless supply of fluid
en_us.create.ponder.creative_fluid_tank.text_2: Right-Click with a fluid containing item to configure it
en_us.create.ponder.creative_fluid_tank.text_3: Pipe Networks can now endlessly draw the assigned fluid from the tank
en_us.create.ponder.creative_fluid_tank.text_4: Any Fluids pushed back into a Creative Fluid Tank will be voided
en_us.create.ponder.creative_motor.header: Generating Rotational Force using Creative Motors
en_us.create.ponder.creative_motor.text_1: Creative motors are a compact and configurable source of Rotational Force
en_us.create.ponder.creative_motor.text_2: The generated speed can be configured on its input panels
en_us.create.ponder.creative_motor_mojang.head: Mojang's Enigma
en_us.create.ponder.crushing_wheels.text_1: A pair of Crushing Wheels can grind items very effectively
en_us.create.ponder.crushing_wheels.text_2: Their Rotational Input has to make them spin into each other
en_us.create.ponder.crushing_wheels.text_3: Items thrown or inserted into the top will get processed
en_us.create.ponder.crushing_wheels.text_4: Items can be inserted and picked up through automated means as well
en_us.create.ponder.deployer.text_1: Given Rotational Force, a Deployer can imitate player interactions
en_us.create.ponder.deployer.text_10: Right-click the front to give it an Item to use
en_us.create.ponder.deployer.text_11: Items can also be inserted automatically
en_us.create.ponder.deployer.text_13: When a filter is set, it activates only while holding a matching item
en_us.create.ponder.deployer.text_14: Only items matching the filter can now be inserted...
en_us.create.ponder.deployer.text_15: ...and only non-matching items will be extracted
en_us.create.ponder.deployer.text_2: It will always interact with the position 2 blocks in front of itself
en_us.create.ponder.deployer.text_3: Blocks directly in front will not obstruct it
en_us.create.ponder.deployer_contraption.text_: Whenever Deployers are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
They activate at each visited location, using items from inventories anywhere on the contraption
The Filter slot can be used to specify which items to pull
en_us.create.ponder.deployer_modes.text_1: By default, a Deployer imitates a Right-click interaction
en_us.create.ponder.deployer_modes.text_2: Using a Wrench, it can be set to imitate a Left-click instead
en_us.create.ponder.deployer_processing.text_1: With a fitting held item, Deployers can process items provided beneath them
en_us.create.ponder.deployer_processing.text_2: The Input items can be dropped or placed on a Depot under the Deployer
en_us.create.ponder.deployer_processing.text_3: When items are provided on a belt...
en_us.create.ponder.deployer_processing.text_4: The Deployer will hold and process them automatically
en_us.create.ponder.deployer_redstone.text_1: When powered by Redstone, Deployers will not activate
en_us.create.ponder.deployer_redstone.text_2: Before stopping, the Deployer will finish any started cycles
en_us.create.ponder.deployer_redstone.text_3: Thus, a negative pulse can be used to trigger exactly one activation cycle
en_us.create.ponder.depot.text_1: Depots can serve as 'stationary' belt elements
en_us.create.ponder.depot.text_2: Right-Click to manually place or remove Items from it
en_us.create.ponder.depot.text_3: Just like Mechanical Belts, it can provide items to processing
en_us.create.ponder.depot.text_4: ...as well as provide Items to Mechanical Arms
en_us.create.ponder.display_board.text_1: Display Boards are a scalable alternative to the sign
en_us.create.ponder.display_board.text_2: They require Rotational Force to operate
en_us.create.ponder.display_board.text_3: Static text can be applied using written Clipboards
en_us.create.ponder.display_board.text_4: And dynamic text through the use of Display Links
en_us.create.ponder.display_board.text_5: Dyes can be applied to individual lines of the board
en_us.create.ponder.display_board.text_6: Lines can be reset by clicking them with an empty hand
en_us.create.ponder.display_link.text_1: Display Links can be used to visualise dynamic information
en_us.create.ponder.display_link.text_3: ...then attach it to the block to read from
en_us.create.ponder.display_link.text_4: Open the Interface to select and configure what is sent
en_us.create.ponder.display_link.text_5: The display will now receive information from the link
en_us.create.ponder.display_link.text_6: Not every block can act as a source
en_us.create.ponder.display_link.text_7: Each compatible block provides unique information
en_us.create.ponder.display_link.text_8: The Display Link can work with several different displays
en_us.create.ponder.display_link_redstone.head: Redstone Control
en_us.create.ponder.display_link_redstone.text: When powered by Redstone, Display Links stop sending updates
Once unpowered, the Timer is reset and new info is sent immediately
Signals emitted from the source do not affect the Link
en_us.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_1: Elevator Pulleys can move structures vertically between marked locations
en_us.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_10: Any redstone contact sharing this column will be converted
en_us.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_11: Supply a redstone pulse to call the elevator to the contact
en_us.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_12: The movement speed depends on the rotation input on the pulley
en_us.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_13: Scroll and click on the controls block to choose a floor while on-board
en_us.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_14: Right-Clicking the assembled pulley will turn the cabin back into blocks
en_us.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_15: Sliding doors attached to the cabin will open and close automatically
en_us.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_16: Elevator Contacts emit a signal while the cabin is on their floor
en_us.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_17: This can be useful to trigger doors or special effects upon arrival
en_us.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_18: Display Links on any of the contacts can show the current floor of the elevator
en_us.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_3: Place a pair of Redstone Contacts facing each other...
en_us.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_4: ...and glue one of them to your moving structure
en_us.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_5: Contraption Controls can be attached to make floor selection easier
en_us.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_6: Ensure that the pulley is supplied with Rotational Power
en_us.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_7: Right-Clicking the pulley assembles the elevator
en_us.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_8: The stationary contact now turns into an Elevator Contact
en_us.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_9: Elevator Contacts represent a 'floor' and can be configured
en_us.create.ponder.elevator_pulley_multi_rope: Whenever a pulley assembles a contraption...
...other pulleys on the same layer will connect to the structure
They do not require to be powered, the effect is purely cosmetic
en_us.create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_1: Right-click a Blaze with the empty burner to capture it
en_us.create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_2: Alternatively, Blazes can be collected from their Spawners directly
en_us.create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_3: You now have an ideal heat source for various machines
en_us.create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_4: For Aesthetic purposes, Empty Blaze Burners can also be lit using Flint and Steel
en_us.create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_5: The flame can be transformed using a soul-infused item
en_us.create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_6: However, without a blaze they are not suitable for industrial heating
en_us.create.ponder.encased_fluid_pipe.text_1: Copper Casing can be used to decorate Fluid Pipes
en_us.create.ponder.encased_fluid_pipe.text_2: Aside from being concealed, Encased Pipes are locked into their connectivity state
en_us.create.ponder.encased_fluid_pipe.text_3: It will no longer react to any neighbouring blocks being added or removed
en_us.create.ponder.factory_gauge_crafting.tex: Factory gauges provide auto-arrangement for crafting table recipes
Connect the required ingredients as before
When a valid recipe is detected, a new button appears in the UI
With auto-arrangement active, the boxes can be unwrapped into crafters directly
The setup must be 3x3 and the crafters have to be connected via wrench
Hold Right-click on the gauge to set the target amount
This crafter can now be used universally, by more gauges with different recipes
Outputs should be sent back to a linked inventory to close the loop
Using a Re-packager is recommended to prevent fragmentation of input packages
en_us.create.ponder.factory_gauge_links.text_1: When adding a new connection from the UI...
en_us.create.ponder.factory_gauge_links.text_2: ...the gauge also accepts Redstone and Display Links
en_us.create.ponder.factory_gauge_links.text_3: Redstone links will be powered when the stock level is at or above the target amount
en_us.create.ponder.factory_gauge_links.text_4: In receiver mode, links can stop the gauge from sending requests
en_us.create.ponder.factory_gauge_links.text_5: Display links can provide a status overview of connected gauges
en_us.create.ponder.factory_gauge_recipe.text_: Whenever gauges are not placed on a packager...
Specify the address that ingredients should be sent to
The target amount to maintain can now be set by holding Right-click on the gauge
Whenever the network has fewer items than the amount...
...it will send new ingredients to the specified address
The outputs then need to return to any of the linked inventories
Green connections indicate that the target amount has been reached
The board of gauges can expand to include more recipe steps
Each gauge maintains the stock level of its item independently
They will instead monitor stock levels of all linked inventories
Right-click it with the item that should be monitored
It will now display the total amount present on the network
The gauge can replenish stock levels by sending other items to be processed
First, add the required ingredients as new factory gauges
From the target's UI, new connections can be made
For aesthetics, input panels can be wrenched to change the pathing
In the UI, review the inputs and specify how much of the output gets made per batch
en_us.create.ponder.factory_gauge_restocker.te: Right-click a Stock link before placement to connect to its network
...the logistics network sends more, with the specified address
From there, they can be routed to the packager
When placed on a packager, factory gauges can monitor items inside the inventory
Right-click it with the item that should be monitored
It will now display the amount present in the inventory
The gauge can refill this inventory from the logistics network
Right-click it again to open its configuration UI
Set an address that should be used for the requested items
The target amount to maintain can now be set by holding Right-click on the gauge
Whenever the chest has fewer items than this amount...
en_us.create.ponder.fan_direction.text_1: Encased Fans use Rotational Force to create an Air Current
en_us.create.ponder.fan_direction.text_2: Strength and Direction of Flow depends on the Rotational Input
en_us.create.ponder.fan_processing.text_1: When passing through lava, the Air Flow becomes Heated
en_us.create.ponder.fan_processing.text_2: Items caught in the area will be smelted
en_us.create.ponder.fan_processing.text_3: Food items thrown here would be incinerated
en_us.create.ponder.fan_processing.text_4: Instead, a setup for Smoking using Fire should be used for them
en_us.create.ponder.fan_processing.text_5: Air Flows passing through water create a Washing Setup
en_us.create.ponder.fan_processing.text_6: Some interesting new processing can be done with it
en_us.create.ponder.fan_processing.text_7: The Speed of the Fan does NOT affect the processing speed, only its range
en_us.create.ponder.fan_processing.text_8: Fan Processing can also be applied to Items on Depots and Belts
en_us.create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_1: Fluid Pipes can connect two or more fluid sources and targets
en_us.create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_2: Using a wrench, a straight pipe segment can be given a window
en_us.create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_3: Windowed pipes will not connect to any other adjacent pipe segments
en_us.create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_4: Powered by Mechanical Pumps, the Pipes can transport Fluids
en_us.create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_5: No fluid is being extracted at first
en_us.create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_6: Once the flow connects them, the endpoints gradually transfer their contents
en_us.create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_7: Thus, the Pipe blocks themselves never 'physically' contain any fluid
en_us.create.ponder.fluid_pipe_interaction.tex: Endpoints of a pipe network can interact with a variety of blocks
Any block with fluid storage capabilities can be filled or drained
Source blocks right in front of an open end can be picked up...
...while spilling into empty spaces can create fluid sources
Pipes can also extract fluids from a handful of other blocks directly
en_us.create.ponder.fluid_tank_sizes.text_1: Fluid Tanks can be combined to increase the total capacity
en_us.create.ponder.fluid_tank_sizes.text_2: Their base square can be up to 3 blocks wide...
en_us.create.ponder.fluid_tank_sizes.text_3: ...and grow in height by more than 30 additional layers
en_us.create.ponder.fluid_tank_sizes.text_4: Using a Wrench, a tanks' window can be toggled
en_us.create.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.text_1: Fluid Tanks can be used to store large amounts of fluid
en_us.create.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.text_2: Pipe networks can push and pull fluids from any side
en_us.create.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.text_3: The contained fluid can be measured by a Comparator
en_us.create.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.text_4: However, in Survival Mode Fluids cannot be added or taken manually
en_us.create.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.text_5: You can use Basins, Item Drains and Spouts to drain or fill fluid containing items
en_us.create.ponder.funnel_compat.text_1: Funnels should also interact nicely with a handful of other components.
en_us.create.ponder.funnel_direction.text_1: Placed normally, it pulls items from the inventory.
en_us.create.ponder.funnel_direction.text_2: Placed while sneaking, it puts items into the inventory.
en_us.create.ponder.funnel_direction.text_3: Using a wrench, the funnel can be flipped after placement.
en_us.create.ponder.funnel_direction.text_4: Same rules will apply for most orientations.
en_us.create.ponder.funnel_direction.text_5: Funnels on belts will extract/insert depending on its movement direction.
en_us.create.ponder.funnel_intro.text_1: Funnels are ideal for transferring items from and to inventories.
en_us.create.ponder.funnel_redstone.text_1: Redstone power will prevent any funnel from acting
en_us.create.ponder.funnel_transfer.text_1: Funnels cannot ever transfer between closed inventories directly.
en_us.create.ponder.funnel_transfer.text_2: Chutes or Smart chutes might be more suitable for such purposes.
en_us.create.ponder.funnel_transfer.text_3: Same applies for horizontal movement. A mechanical belt should help here.
en_us.create.ponder.gantry_carriage.text_1: Gantry Carriages can mount to and slide along a Gantry Shaft.
en_us.create.ponder.gantry_carriage.text_2: Gantry setups can move attached Blocks.
en_us.create.ponder.gantry_cascaded.text_1: Gantry shafts attach to a carriage without the need of super glue
en_us.create.ponder.gantry_cascaded.text_2: Same applies for carriages on moved Gantry Shafts
en_us.create.ponder.gantry_cascaded.text_3: Thus, a gantry system can be cascaded to cover multiple axes of movement
en_us.create.ponder.gantry_direction.text_1: Gantry Shafts can have opposite orientations
en_us.create.ponder.gantry_direction.text_2: The movement direction of carriages depend on their shafts' orientation
en_us.create.ponder.gantry_direction.text_3: ...as well as the rotation direction of the shaft
en_us.create.ponder.gantry_direction.text_4: Same rules apply for the propagated rotation
en_us.create.ponder.gantry_redstone.text_1: Redstone-powered gantry shafts stop moving their carriages
en_us.create.ponder.gantry_redstone.text_2: Instead, its rotational force is relayed to the carriages' output shaft
en_us.create.ponder.gantry_shaft.text_1: Gantry Shafts form the basis of a gantry setup. Attached Carriages will move along them.
en_us.create.ponder.gantry_shaft.text_2: Gantry setups can move attached Blocks.
en_us.create.ponder.gearbox.text_1: Jumping between axes of rotation can get bulky quickly
en_us.create.ponder.gearbox.text_2: A gearbox is the more compact equivalent of this setup
en_us.create.ponder.gearbox.text_3: Shafts around corners rotate in mirrored directions
en_us.create.ponder.gearshift.header: Controlling rotational force using a Gearshift
en_us.create.ponder.gearshift.text_1: Gearshifts will relay rotation in a straight line
en_us.create.ponder.gearshift.text_2: When powered by Redstone, it reverses the transmission
en_us.create.ponder.hand_crank.header: Generating Rotational Force using Hand Cranks
en_us.create.ponder.hand_crank.text_1: Hand Cranks can be used by players to apply rotational force manually
en_us.create.ponder.hand_crank.text_2: Hold Right-Click to rotate it Counter-Clockwise
en_us.create.ponder.hand_crank.text_3: Sneak and Hold Right-Click to rotate it Clockwise
en_us.create.ponder.hose_pulley.header: Source Filling and Draining using Hose Pulleys
en_us.create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_1: Hose Pulleys can be used to fill or drain large bodies of Fluid
en_us.create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_2: With the Kinetic Input, the height of the pulleys' hose can be controlled
en_us.create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_3: The Pulley retracts while the input rotation is inverted
en_us.create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_4: On the opposite side, pipes can be connected
en_us.create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_5: Attached pipe networks can either provide fluid to the hose...
en_us.create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_6: ...or pull from it, draining the pool instead
en_us.create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_7: Fill and Drain speed of the pulley depends entirely on the fluid networks' throughput
en_us.create.ponder.hose_pulley_infinite.heade: Passively Filling and Draining large bodies of Fluid
en_us.create.ponder.hose_pulley_infinite.text_: When deploying the Hose Pulley into a large enough ocean...
It will provide/dispose fluids without affecting the source
Pipe networks can limitlessly take fluids from/to such pulleys
en_us.create.ponder.hose_pulley_level.header: Fill and Drain level of Hose Pulleys
en_us.create.ponder.hose_pulley_level.text_1: While fully retracted, the Hose Pulley cannot operate
en_us.create.ponder.hose_pulley_level.text_2: Draining runs from top to bottom
en_us.create.ponder.hose_pulley_level.text_3: The surface level will end up just below where the hose ends
en_us.create.ponder.hose_pulley_level.text_4: Filling runs from bottom to top
en_us.create.ponder.hose_pulley_level.text_5: The filled pool will not grow beyond the layer above the hose end
en_us.create.ponder.item_drain.header: Emptying Fluid Containers using Item Drains
en_us.create.ponder.item_drain.text_1: Item Drains can extract fluids from items
en_us.create.ponder.item_drain.text_2: Right-click it to pour fluids from your held item into it
en_us.create.ponder.item_drain.text_3: When items are inserted from the side...
en_us.create.ponder.item_drain.text_4: ...they roll across, emptying out their contained fluid
en_us.create.ponder.item_drain.text_5: Pipe Networks can now pull the fluid from the drains' internal buffer
en_us.create.ponder.item_vault_sizes.text_1: Item Vaults can be combined to increase the total capacity
en_us.create.ponder.item_vault_sizes.text_2: Their base square can be up to 3 blocks wide...
en_us.create.ponder.item_vault_sizes.text_3: ...and grow in length up to 3x their diameter
en_us.create.ponder.item_vault_storage.text_1: Item Vaults can be used to store large amounts of items
en_us.create.ponder.item_vault_storage.text_2: However, contents cannot be added or taken manually
en_us.create.ponder.item_vault_storage.text_3: Any components for item transfer can both insert...
en_us.create.ponder.large_cogwheel.header: Relaying rotational force using Large Cogwheels
en_us.create.ponder.large_cogwheel.text_1: Large cogwheels can connect to each other at right angles
en_us.create.ponder.large_cogwheel.text_2: It will help relaying conveyed speed to other axes of rotation
en_us.create.ponder.large_water_wheel.header: Generating Rotational Force using Large Water Wheels
en_us.create.ponder.large_water_wheel.text_1: Large Water Wheels draw force from adjacent Water Currents
en_us.create.ponder.large_water_wheel.text_2: Covering additional sides will not improve its kinetic output further
en_us.create.ponder.large_water_wheel.text_3: These rotate only at half the speed of regular water wheels...
en_us.create.ponder.large_water_wheel.text_4: ...but provide a substantially higher stress capacity
en_us.create.ponder.large_water_wheel.text_5: Use wood planks on the wheel to change its appearance
The open faces of a Linear Chassis can be made Sticky
Click again to make the opposite side sticky
Sneak and Right-Click with an empty hand to remove the slime
Stickied faces of the Linear Chassis will attach a line of blocks in front of it
Using a Wrench, a precise Range can be specified for this chassis
Holding CTRL adjusts the range of all connected Chassis Blocks
Attaching blocks to any other side requires the use of Super Glue
Using these mechanics, structures of any shape can move as a Contraption
en_us.create.ponder.linear_chassis_group.text_: Linear Chassis connect to identical Chassis blocks next to them
When one is moved by a Contraption, the others are dragged with it
Chassis of a different type or facing another direction will not attach
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_1: Mechanical Arms have to be assigned their in- and outputs before they are placed
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_2: Right-Click inventories while holding the Arm to assign them as Targets
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_3: Right-Click again to toggle between Input (Blue) and Output (Yellow)
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_4: Left-Click components to remove their Selection
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_5: Once placed, the Mechanical Arm will target the blocks selected previously
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_6: They can have any amount of in- and outputs within their range
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_7: However, not every type of Inventory can be interacted with directly
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_8: Funnels and Depots can help to Bridge that gap
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_arm_filtering.h: Filtering Outputs of the Mechanical Arm
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_arm_filtering.t: Sometimes it is desirable to restrict targets of the Arm by matching a filter
Mechanical Arms by themselves do not provide any options for filtering
Brass Funnels as Targets do however communicate their own filter to the Arm
The Arm is smart enough not to pick up items it couldn't distribute
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_arm_modes.heade: Distribution modes of the Mechanical Arm
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_arm_modes.text_: Whenever an Arm has to choose between multiple valid outputs...
...it will act according to its setting
The value panel will allow you to configure it
Round Robin mode simply cycles through all outputs that are available
If an output is unable to take more items, it will be skipped
Forced Round Robin mode will never skip outputs, and instead wait until they are free
Prefer First prioritizes the outputs selected earliest when configuring this Arm
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_arm_redstone.te: When powered by Redstone, Mechanical Arms will not activate
Before stopping, it will finish any started cycles
Thus, a negative pulse can be used to trigger exactly one activation cycle
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_bearing.header: Moving Structures using the Mechanical Bearing
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_bearing.text_1: Mechanical Bearings attach to the block in front of them
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_bearing.text_2: Upon receiving Rotational Force, it will assemble it into a Rotating Contraption
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_1: An array of Mechanical Crafters can be used to automate any Crafting Recipe
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_2: Using a Wrench, the Crafters' paths can be arranged
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_3: For a valid setup, all paths have to converge into one exit at any side
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_4: The outputs will be placed into the inventory at the exit
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_5: Mechanical Crafters require Rotational Force to operate
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_6: Right-Click the front to insert Items manually
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_7: Once every slot of a path contains an Item, the crafting process will begin
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_8: For recipes not fully occupying the crafter setup, the start can be forced using a Redstone Pulse
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_crafter_connect: Items can be inserted to Crafters automatically
Using the Wrench at their backs, Mechanical Crafter inputs can be combined
All connected Crafters can now be accessed by the same input location
Some recipes will require additional Crafters to bridge gaps in the path
Using Slot Covers, Crafters can be set to act as an Empty Slot in the arrangement
Shared Inputs created with the Wrench at the back can also reach across covered Crafters
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_drill.header: Breaking Blocks with the Mechanical Drill
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_drill.text_1: When given Rotational Force, a Mechanical Drill will break blocks directly in front of it
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_drill.text_2: Its mining speed depends on the Rotational Input
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_drill_contrapti: Whenever Drills are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
...they will break blocks the contraption runs them into
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_harvester.text_: Whenever Harvesters are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
They will harvest and reset any mature crops on their way
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.header: Processing Items with the Mechanical Mixer
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.text_1: With a Mixer and Basin, some Crafting Recipes can be automated
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.text_2: Available recipes include any Shapeless Crafting Recipe, plus a couple extra ones
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.text_3: Some of those recipes may require the heat of a Blaze Burner
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.text_4: The filter slot can be used in case two recipes are conflicting.
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_piston.text_1: Mechanical Pistons can move blocks in front of them
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_piston.text_2: Speed and direction of movement depend on the Rotational Input
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_piston.text_3: Sticky Mechanical Pistons can pull the attached blocks back
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_piston_modes.he: Movement Modes of the Mechanical Piston
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_piston_modes.te: Whenever Pistons stop moving, the moved structure reverts to blocks
It can be configured never to revert to solid blocks, or only at the location it started at
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_plough.text_1: Whenever Ploughs are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_plough.text_2: ...they will break blocks without a solid collision hitbox
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_plough.text_4: ...they can also launch entities without hurting them
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_press.header: Processing Items with the Mechanical Press
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_press.text_1: The Mechanical Press can process items provided beneath it
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_press.text_2: The Input items can be dropped or placed on a Depot under the Press
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_press.text_3: When items are provided on a belt...
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_press.text_4: The Press will hold and process them automatically
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_press_compactin: Compacting items with the Mechanical Press
Pressing items held in a Basin will cause them to be Compacted
Compacting includes any filled 2x2 or 3x3 Crafting Recipe, plus a couple extra ones
Some of those recipes may require the heat of a Blaze Burner
The filter slot can be used in case two recipes are conflicting.
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_pump_flow.text_: Mechanical Pumps govern the flow of their attached pipe networks
Their arrow indicates the direction of flow
The network behind is now pulling fluids...
...while the network in front is transferring it outward
The pumps direction is unaffected by the input rotation
Instead, a Wrench can be used to reverse the direction
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_pump_speed.head: Throughput of Mechanical Pumps
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_pump_speed.text: Regardless of speed, Mechanical Pumps affect pipes connected up to 16 blocks away
Speeding up the input rotation changes the speed of flow propagation...
...and the speed at which fluids are transferred
Pumps can combine their throughputs within shared pipe networks
Ensure that all of them are facing in the same direction
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_roller_fill.tex: While disassembled, rollers can be set to other modes
The 'fill' modes can help to bridge gaps between pavement and terrain
On 'straight fill', they will place simple columns down to the surface
On 'sloped fill', layers placed further down will increase in size
As opposed to 'clear & pave', neither of these modes will cause the rollers to break existing blocks
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_roller_pave.hea: Clearing and Paving with the Roller
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_roller_pave.tex: Mechanical rollers help to clean up terrain around tracks or paths
In its default mode, without a material set, it will simply clear blocks like a Drill
While disassembled, a suitable paving material can be specified
Materials can be supplied via chests or barrels attached to the structure
In addition to breaking blocks, it will now replace the layer beneath them
Note that any block destroyed by a roller has a chance not to yield drops
Rollers are especially useful on Trains, but can also be used on most other types of moving contraptions
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_saw_breaker.hea: Cutting Trees with the Mechanical Saw
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_saw_breaker.tex: When given Rotational Force, a Mechanical Saw will cut trees directly in front of it
In order to cut the tree fully, the Saw has to break the last block connecting it to the ground
en_us.create.ponder.mechanical_saw_contraption: Whenever Saws are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
...they will cut any trees the contraption runs them into
Processing Items on the Mechanical Saw
Upward facing Mechanical Saws can process a variety of items
The processed item always moves against the rotational input to the saw
Saws can work in-line with Mechanical Belts
When an ingredient has multiple possible outcomes, the filter slot can specify it
Without filter, the Saw would cycle through all outcomes instead
en_us.create.ponder.millstone.text_1: Millstones process items by grinding them
en_us.create.ponder.millstone.text_2: They can be powered from the side using cogwheels
en_us.create.ponder.millstone.text_3: Throw or Insert items at the top
en_us.create.ponder.millstone.text_4: After some time, the result can be obtained via Right-click
en_us.create.ponder.millstone.text_5: The outputs can also be extracted by automation
en_us.create.ponder.nixie_tube.text_1: When powered by Redstone, Nixie Tubes will display the signal strength
en_us.create.ponder.nixie_tube.text_2: Using written Clipboards, custom text can be displayed
en_us.create.ponder.nixie_tube.text_3: Right-Click with Dye to change their display colour
en_us.create.ponder.package_frogport.text_1: Right-click a Chain Conveyor and place the Frogport nearby
en_us.create.ponder.package_frogport.text_10: Packages find their path to a matching frog on the chain network
en_us.create.ponder.package_frogport.text_13: Frogports can directly interface with inventories below them
en_us.create.ponder.package_frogport.text_14: This also works with packagers. Items can be packed and shipped directly
en_us.create.ponder.package_frogport.text_18: Right-click Frogports with a clipboard to collect their address
en_us.create.ponder.package_frogport.text_19: Clipboards with collected names can help auto-complete address inputs in other UIs
en_us.create.ponder.package_frogport.text_2: Assign it an address in the inventory UI
en_us.create.ponder.package_frogport.text_3: If the address of an inserted package does not match it..
en_us.create.ponder.package_frogport.text_6: ..the Frogport will place the package on the conveyor
en_us.create.ponder.package_frogport.text_7: Packages spin in place if they have no valid destination
en_us.create.ponder.package_frogport.text_8: More Frogports can be added anywhere on the chain network
en_us.create.ponder.packager.text_1: Attach packagers to the inventory they should target
en_us.create.ponder.packager.text_2: Given redstone power, it will pack items from the inventory into a package
en_us.create.ponder.packager.text_3: These can be picked up and transported like any other item
en_us.create.ponder.packager.text_4: Packages inserted will be destroyed, unpacking the contents into the inventory
en_us.create.ponder.packager.text_6: Packagers will not accept packages they cannot fully unpack
en_us.create.ponder.packager_address.text_10: For compactness, mechanical saws can unpack straight onto a belt
en_us.create.ponder.packager_address.text_11: Aside from filters, Frogports and Postboxes have package routing abilities
en_us.create.ponder.packager_address.text_12: Inspect them to find out more about their behaviour
en_us.create.ponder.packager_address.text_2: When a sign is placed on a packager..
en_us.create.ponder.packager_address.text_4: Created packages will carry the written lines of text as their address
en_us.create.ponder.packager_address.text_5: Package filters route packages based on their address
en_us.create.ponder.piston_pole.text_1: Without attached Poles, a Mechanical Piston cannot move
en_us.create.ponder.piston_pole.text_2: The Length of pole added at its back determines the Extension Range
en_us.create.ponder.portable_fluid_interface.t: Fluid Tanks on moving contraptions cannot be accessed by any pipes
This component can interact with fluid tanks without the need to stop the contraption
Place a second one with a gap of 1 or 2 blocks inbetween
Whenever they pass by each other, they will engage in a connection
While engaged, the stationary interface will represent ALL Tanks on the contraption
After no contents have been exchanged for a while, the contraption will continue on its way
en_us.create.ponder.portable_storage_interface: Moving inventories can be tricky to access with automation.
This component can interact with storage without the need to stop the contraption.
Place a second one with a gap of 1 or 2 blocks inbetween
Whenever they pass by each other, they will engage in a connection
While engaged, the stationary interface will represent ALL inventories on the contraption
After no items have been exchanged for a while, the contraption will continue on its way
Redstone power will prevent the stationary interface from engaging
en_us.create.ponder.postbox.text_1: Right-click a Train Station and place the Postbox nearby
en_us.create.ponder.postbox.text_11: Just like trains, Postboxes maintain their behaviour in unloaded chunks
en_us.create.ponder.postbox.text_12: Packages can still be delivered from or to their inventory
en_us.create.ponder.postbox.text_2: Assign it an address in the inventory UI
en_us.create.ponder.postbox.text_3: If the address of an inserted package does not match it..
en_us.create.ponder.postbox.text_6: ..trains stopping at the station will collect it as cargo
en_us.create.ponder.postbox.text_7: Conversely, packages matching the address will be dropped off
en_us.create.ponder.postbox.text_8: Packages that arrived by train can be extracted from the Postbox
en_us.create.ponder.powered_latch.header: Controlling signals using the Powered Latch
en_us.create.ponder.powered_latch.text_1: Powered Latches are redstone controllable Levers
en_us.create.ponder.powered_latch.text_2: Signals at the back switch it on
en_us.create.ponder.powered_latch.text_3: Signals from the side switch it back off
en_us.create.ponder.powered_latch.text_4: Powered latches can also be toggled manually
en_us.create.ponder.powered_toggle_latch.heade: Controlling signals using the Powered Toggle Latch
en_us.create.ponder.powered_toggle_latch.text_: Powered Toggle Latches are redstone controllable Levers
Signals at the back will toggle its state
Powered toggle latches can also be toggled manually
en_us.create.ponder.pulse_extender.text_1: Pulse Extenders can lengthen a signal passing through
en_us.create.ponder.pulse_extender.text_2: They activate after a short delay...
en_us.create.ponder.pulse_extender.text_3: ...and cool down for the configured duration
en_us.create.ponder.pulse_extender.text_4: Using the value panel, the discharge time can be configured
en_us.create.ponder.pulse_extender.text_5: The configured duration can range up to an hour
en_us.create.ponder.pulse_repeater.text_1: Pulse Repeaters emit a short pulse after a delay
en_us.create.ponder.pulse_repeater.text_2: Using the value panel, the charge time can be configured
en_us.create.ponder.pulse_repeater.text_3: Configured delays can range up to an hour
en_us.create.ponder.pulse_timer.header: Redstone output of the Pulse Timer
en_us.create.ponder.pulse_timer.text_1: Pulse Timers repeatedly emit short pulses
en_us.create.ponder.pulse_timer.text_2: Using the value panel, the time interval can be configured
en_us.create.ponder.pulse_timer.text_3: Powering the input side will pause and reset them
en_us.create.ponder.pulse_timer.text_4: Right-click the circuit base to invert the output
en_us.create.ponder.pulse_timer.text_5: This helps trigger mechanisms that activate only without a redstone signal
en_us.create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_1: Radial Chassis connect to identical Chassis blocks in a row
en_us.create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_2: When one is moved by a Contraption, the others are dragged with it
en_us.create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_3: The side faces of a Radial Chassis can be made Sticky
en_us.create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_4: Click again to make all other sides sticky
en_us.create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_5: Sneak and Right-Click with an empty hand to remove the slime
en_us.create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_6: Whenever a Block is next to a sticky face...
en_us.create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_7: ...it will attach all reachable blocks within a radius on that layer
en_us.create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_8: Using a Wrench, a precise Radius can be specified for this chassis
en_us.create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_9: Blocks not reachable by any sticky face will not attach
en_us.create.ponder.redstone_contact.text_1: Redstone Contacts facing each other will emit a redstone signal
en_us.create.ponder.redstone_contact.text_2: This still applies when one of them is part of a moving Contraption
en_us.create.ponder.redstone_link.text_1: Redstone Links can transmit redstone signals wirelessly
en_us.create.ponder.redstone_link.text_2: Right-click while Sneaking to toggle receive mode
en_us.create.ponder.redstone_link.text_3: A simple Right-click with a Wrench can do the same
en_us.create.ponder.redstone_link.text_4: Receivers emit the redstone power of transmitters within 256 blocks
en_us.create.ponder.redstone_link.text_5: Placing items in the two slots can specify a Frequency
en_us.create.ponder.redstone_link.text_6: Only the links with matching Frequencies will communicate
en_us.create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_1: Right-click a Stock link before placement to connect to its network
en_us.create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_2: Just like Stock tickers, Redstone requesters can order items from the logistics network
en_us.create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_3: Right-click the requester to open its configuration UI
en_us.create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_4: The order set in the UI will be requested on every redstone pulse
en_us.create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_5: Alternatively, the requester can be fully configured before placement
en_us.create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_6: Right-click a Stock keeper with it and set the desired order there
en_us.create.ponder.repackager.text_1: Sometimes, it is crucial for logistical requests to arrive as a single package
en_us.create.ponder.repackager.text_4: Otherwise, other packages could arrive inbetween
en_us.create.ponder.repackager.text_5: When this is the case, redirect packages to an inventory
en_us.create.ponder.repackager.text_6: Attach a re-packager, and power it with redstone
en_us.create.ponder.repackager.text_7: Once all fragments arrived, they will be exported as a new package
en_us.create.ponder.repackager.text_8: Now, requested items arrive together and in a predictable order
en_us.create.ponder.rope_pulley.text_1: Rope Pulleys can move blocks vertically when given Rotational Force
en_us.create.ponder.rope_pulley.text_2: Direction and Speed of movement depend on the Rotational Input
en_us.create.ponder.rope_pulley_attachment.hea: Moving Pulleys as part of a Contraption
en_us.create.ponder.rope_pulley_attachment.tex: Whenever Pulleys are themselves being moved by a Contraption...
...its attached structure will be dragged with it
Mind that pulleys are only movable while stopped
en_us.create.ponder.rope_pulley_modes.header: Movement Modes of the Rope Pulley
en_us.create.ponder.rope_pulley_modes.text_1: Whenever Pulleys stop moving, the moved structure reverts to blocks
en_us.create.ponder.rope_pulley_modes.text_2: It can be configured never to revert to solid blocks, or only at the location it started at
en_us.create.ponder.rope_pulley_multi_rope.tex: Whenever a pulley assembles a contraption...
...other pulleys on the same layer will connect to the structure
They do not require to be powered, the effect is purely cosmetic
en_us.create.ponder.rose_quartz_lamp.text_1: Rose Quartz Lamps activate on a Redstone signal
en_us.create.ponder.rose_quartz_lamp.text_2: They will continue to emit redstone power afterwards
en_us.create.ponder.rose_quartz_lamp.text_3: When multiple lamps are arranged in a group...
en_us.create.ponder.rose_quartz_lamp.text_4: ...activating a Lamp will focus the signal to it, deactivating all others
en_us.create.ponder.rose_quartz_lamp.text_5: Comparators output based on the distance to a powered lamp
en_us.create.ponder.rose_quartz_lamp.text_6: The Lamps can also be toggled manually using a Wrench
Rot. Speed Controllers relay rotation from their axis to a Large Cogwheel above them
Using the value panel on its side, the conveyed speed can be configured
en_us.create.ponder.sail.text_1: Sails are handy blocks to create Windmills with
en_us.create.ponder.sail.text_2: They will attach to blocks and each other without the need of Super Glue or Chassis Blocks
en_us.create.ponder.sail.text_3: Right-Click with Dye to paint them
en_us.create.ponder.sail.text_4: Right-Click with Shears to turn them back into frames
en_us.create.ponder.sail_frame.text_1: Sail Frames are handy blocks to create Windmills with
en_us.create.ponder.sail_frame.text_2: They will attach to blocks and each other without the need of Super Glue or Chassis Blocks
en_us.create.ponder.sequenced_gearshift.header: Controlling Rotational Speed using Sequenced Gearshifts
en_us.create.ponder.sequenced_gearshift.text_1: Seq. Gearshifts relay rotation by following a timed list of instructions
en_us.create.ponder.sequenced_gearshift.text_2: Right-click it to open the Configuration UI
en_us.create.ponder.sequenced_gearshift.text_3: Upon receiving a Redstone Signal, it will start running its configured sequence
en_us.create.ponder.sequenced_gearshift.text_4: Once finished, it waits for the next Redstone Signal and starts over
en_us.create.ponder.sequenced_gearshift.text_5: A redstone comparator can be used to read the current progress
en_us.create.ponder.shaft.text_1: Shafts will relay rotation in a straight line.
en_us.create.ponder.shaft_casing.text_1: Brass or Andesite Casing can be used to decorate Shafts
en_us.create.ponder.shared.behaviour_modify_va: This behaviour can be modified using the value panel
en_us.create.ponder.shared.movement_anchors: With the help of Super Glue, larger structures can be moved.
en_us.create.ponder.shared.storage_on_contrapt: Inventories attached to the Contraption will pick up their drops automatically
en_us.create.ponder.smart_chute.text_1: Smart Chutes are vertical chutes with additional control
en_us.create.ponder.smart_chute.text_2: Items in the filter slot specify what to extract or transfer
en_us.create.ponder.smart_chute.text_3: Use the value panel to specify the extracted stack size
en_us.create.ponder.smart_chute.text_4: Redstone power will prevent Smart Chutes from acting.
en_us.create.ponder.smart_observer.text_1: Smart Observers can be used to detect a variety of events
en_us.create.ponder.smart_observer.text_2: It can detect items or fluids inside of generic containers
en_us.create.ponder.smart_observer.text_3: The filter slot can be used to look for specific contents only
en_us.create.ponder.smart_observer.text_4: It also activates when the block itself matches the filter
en_us.create.ponder.smart_observer.text_5: Additionally, smart observers can monitor belts, chutes and pipes
en_us.create.ponder.smart_observer.text_6: ...and will emit a pulse, if an item enters or exits a funnel
en_us.create.ponder.smart_pipe.header: Controlling Fluid flow using Smart Pipes
en_us.create.ponder.smart_pipe.text_1: Smart pipes can help control flows by fluid type
en_us.create.ponder.smart_pipe.text_2: When placed directly at the source, they can specify the type of fluid to extract
en_us.create.ponder.smart_pipe.text_3: Simply Right-Click their filter slot with any item containing the desired fluid
en_us.create.ponder.smart_pipe.text_4: When placed further down a pipe network, smart pipes will only let matching fluids continue
en_us.create.ponder.speedometer.header: Monitoring Kinetic information using the Speedometer
en_us.create.ponder.speedometer.text_1: The Speedometer displays the current Speed of attached components
en_us.create.ponder.speedometer.text_2: When wearing Engineers' Goggles, the player can get more detailed information from the Gauge
en_us.create.ponder.speedometer.text_3: Comparators can emit analog Redstone Signals relative to the Speedometer's measurements
en_us.create.ponder.spout_filling.text_1: The Spout can fill fluid holding items provided beneath it
en_us.create.ponder.spout_filling.text_2: The content of a Spout cannot be accessed manually
en_us.create.ponder.spout_filling.text_3: Instead, Pipes can be used to supply it with fluids
en_us.create.ponder.spout_filling.text_4: The Input items can be placed on a Depot under the Spout
en_us.create.ponder.spout_filling.text_5: When items are provided on a belt...
en_us.create.ponder.spout_filling.text_6: The Spout will hold and process them automatically
en_us.create.ponder.stabilized_bearings.text_1: Whenever Mechanical Bearings are themselves part of a moving Structure..
en_us.create.ponder.stabilized_bearings.text_2: ..they will attempt to keep themselves upright
en_us.create.ponder.stabilized_bearings.text_3: Once again, the bearing will attach to the block in front of it
en_us.create.ponder.stabilized_bearings.text_4: As a result, the entire sub-Contraption will stay upright
en_us.create.ponder.steam_engine.text_1: Steam Engines can be placed on a Fluid Tank
en_us.create.ponder.steam_engine.text_2: Clicking the engine with a Shaft creates the Kinetic Output
en_us.create.ponder.steam_engine.text_3: With sufficient Heat, Water and Boiler space...
en_us.create.ponder.steam_engine.text_5: The minimal setup requires 4 Fluid Tanks
en_us.create.ponder.steam_engine.text_6: With the help of Blaze Burners, the power output can be increased
en_us.create.ponder.steam_engine.text_7: Higher power levels require more Water, Size and Heat
en_us.create.ponder.steam_engine.text_8: The boiler's current power level can be inspected with Engineer's Goggles
en_us.create.ponder.steam_engine.text_9: With each added power level, an additional Engine can output at full capacity
en_us.create.ponder.steam_whistle.text_1: Steam Whistles can be placed on a Fluid Tank
en_us.create.ponder.steam_whistle.text_2: If the tank receives sufficient heat...
en_us.create.ponder.steam_whistle.text_3: ...the Whistle will play a note when activated
en_us.create.ponder.steam_whistle.text_4: Use a Whistle item on the block to lower its pitch
en_us.create.ponder.steam_whistle.text_5: Cycle between three different octaves using a Wrench
en_us.create.ponder.steam_whistle.text_6: Engineer's Goggles can help to find out the current pitch of a Whistle
en_us.create.ponder.sticker.text_1: Stickers are ideal for Redstone-controlled block attachment
en_us.create.ponder.sticker.text_2: Upon receiving a signal, it will toggle its state
en_us.create.ponder.sticker.text_3: If it is now moved in a contraption, the block will move with it
en_us.create.ponder.sticker.text_4: Toggled once again, the block is no longer attached
en_us.create.ponder.stock_link.header: Logistics Networks and the Stock Link
en_us.create.ponder.stock_link.text_1: When placed, Stock Links create a new stock network
en_us.create.ponder.stock_link.text_2: Right-click an existing link before placing it to bind them
en_us.create.ponder.stock_link.text_3: Stock-linked packagers make their inventory available to the network
en_us.create.ponder.stock_link.text_4: Other components on the network can now find and request their items
en_us.create.ponder.stock_link.text_5: On request, items from the inventories will be placed into packages
en_us.create.ponder.stock_link.text_6: Stock Link signals have unlimited range, but packages require transportation
en_us.create.ponder.stock_link.text_7: Full redstone power will stop a link from broadcasting
en_us.create.ponder.stock_link.text_8: Analog power lowers the priority of a link, causing others to act first
en_us.create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_1: Right-click a Stock link before placement to connect to its network
en_us.create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_10: Stock tickers can also order blocks required for the schematicannon
en_us.create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_11: Simply hand the printed clipboard it generated to the Stock keeper
en_us.create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_2: Stock-linked packagers make their attached inventory available to the network
en_us.create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_3: Stock tickers can order items from these inventories
en_us.create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_4: Seated mobs or blaze burners in front of it act as the Stock Keeper
en_us.create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_5: Right-click the keeper to start ordering items
en_us.create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_6: When an order is submitted, the items will be placed into packages
en_us.create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_7: From there, they can be transported to the request point
en_us.create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_8: Using attribute or list filters, categories can be added to the item listings
en_us.create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_9: Right-click the Stock ticker to open the category editor
en_us.create.ponder.stock_ticker_address.text_: When ordering items, a target address can be set in the request
Aside from filters, Frogports and Postboxes have package routing abilities
Inspect them to find out more about their behaviour
This address will be on all packages created for the request
Using package filters, this can control where the packages will go
en_us.create.ponder.stressometer.header: Monitoring Kinetic information using the Stressometer
en_us.create.ponder.stressometer.text_1: The Stressometer displays the current Stress Capacity of the attached kinetic network
en_us.create.ponder.stressometer.text_2: When wearing Engineers' Goggles, the player can get more detailed information from the Gauge
en_us.create.ponder.stressometer.text_3: Comparators can emit analog Redstone Signals relative to the Stressometer's measurements
en_us.create.ponder.super_glue.text_1: Super Glue groups blocks together into moving contraptions
en_us.create.ponder.super_glue.text_2: Clicking two endpoints creates a new 'glued' area
en_us.create.ponder.super_glue.text_3: To remove a box, punch it with the glue item in hand
en_us.create.ponder.super_glue.text_4: Adjacent blocks sharing an area will pull each other along
en_us.create.ponder.super_glue.text_5: Overlapping glue volumes will move together
en_us.create.ponder.super_glue.text_6: Blocks hanging on others usually do not require glue
en_us.create.ponder.table_cloth.text_1: Table cloths can be used to display items
en_us.create.ponder.table_cloth.text_10: When checking out at the cashier, the bought items will be placed into a package
en_us.create.ponder.table_cloth.text_11: From there, they can be transported to the shop front
en_us.create.ponder.table_cloth.text_12: The payments will be stored inside the stock ticker block
en_us.create.ponder.table_cloth.text_2: With the help of a logistics system, they can also be used to sell items
en_us.create.ponder.table_cloth.text_3: Start with the shop's inventory, a Packager and Stock link
en_us.create.ponder.table_cloth.text_4: Bind a Stock ticker to the link and place it in the shop
en_us.create.ponder.table_cloth.text_5: Employ a mob or blaze burner as the shop keeper
en_us.create.ponder.table_cloth.text_6: Fill the shop inventory with items to be sold
en_us.create.ponder.table_cloth.text_7: To create a new trade, interact with the shop keeper while holding a table cloth

en_us.create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_1: Threshold Switches monitor the fill level of containers
en_us.create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_2: When the inventory content exceeds the upper threshold...
en_us.create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_3: ...the switch will change its redstone output
en_us.create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_4: The signal stays until the lower threshold is reached
en_us.create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_5: The redstone output can now be used to control item supply, keeping the buffer filled
en_us.create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_6: The specific thresholds can be changed in the UI
en_us.create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_7: A filter can help to only count specific contents toward the total
en_us.create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_8: Fluid buffers can be monitored in a similar fashion
en_us.create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_9: ...as well as, curiously, the length of an extended rope pulley
en_us.create.ponder.track_chunks.text_1: Tracks stay functional outside of loaded chunks
en_us.create.ponder.track_chunks.text_2: Trains will travel through inactive sections of the world without issue
en_us.create.ponder.track_chunks.text_3: They will still stop at stations or red signals
en_us.create.ponder.track_chunks.text_4: However, Drills and other on-board machines will not operate
en_us.create.ponder.track_chunks.text_5: Once near a Player, the train will re-appear
en_us.create.ponder.track_observer.text_1: Select a Train Track then place the Observer nearby
en_us.create.ponder.track_observer.text_2: The Observer will detect any Trains passing over the marker
en_us.create.ponder.track_observer.text_3: Observers can be filtered to activate for matching cargo
en_us.create.ponder.track_placement.text_1: A new type of rail designed for Train Contraptions
en_us.create.ponder.track_placement.text_2: To place rows of track in bulk, click on an existing track
en_us.create.ponder.track_placement.text_3: Then place or select a second track
en_us.create.ponder.track_placement.text_4: Tracks can also be placed as turns or slopes
en_us.create.ponder.track_placement.text_5: When connecting, tracks will try to make each turn equally sized
en_us.create.ponder.track_placement.text_6: Holding the sprint key while connecting...
en_us.create.ponder.track_placement.text_7: ...will create the longest fitting bend instead
en_us.create.ponder.track_placement.text_8: Materials in the off-hand will be paved under tracks automatically
en_us.create.ponder.track_portal.text_1: Tracks placed up against a nether portal...
en_us.create.ponder.track_portal.text_2: ...will attempt to create a paired track on the other side
en_us.create.ponder.track_portal.text_3: Trains on this track are now able to travel across dimensions
en_us.create.ponder.train_assembly.text_1: Select a Train Track then place the Station nearby
en_us.create.ponder.train_assembly.text_10: Every Train requires Train Controls on board
en_us.create.ponder.train_assembly.text_11: An optional second one allows departure from Stations in both directions
en_us.create.ponder.train_assembly.text_12: Open the Station UI and confirm the Assembly process
en_us.create.ponder.train_assembly.text_13: Trains can be disassembled back into blocks at stations only
en_us.create.ponder.train_assembly.text_14: When used on a station, maps will add a labeled marker at the location
en_us.create.ponder.train_assembly.text_15: Assembled Trains can be relocated to nearby Tracks using the Wrench
en_us.create.ponder.train_assembly.text_2: Stations are the Waypoints of your Track Network
en_us.create.ponder.train_assembly.text_3: To create a new Train, open the UI and switch to Assembly Mode
en_us.create.ponder.train_assembly.text_4: During Assembly no scheduled trains will approach this station
en_us.create.ponder.train_assembly.text_5: Create new bogeys by using Train Casing on Tracks
en_us.create.ponder.train_assembly.text_6: Click the track again to cycle between bogey designs
en_us.create.ponder.train_assembly.text_7: Attach blocks with the help of Super Glue
en_us.create.ponder.train_assembly.text_8: Assembled Trains will move faster if they can find fuel in assembled chests or barrels
en_us.create.ponder.train_assembly.text_9: Fuel stored in Vaults will not be consumed by the train
en_us.create.ponder.train_controls.text_1: Train Controls are required on every train contraption
en_us.create.ponder.train_controls.text_2: Once assembled, right-click the block to start driving
en_us.create.ponder.train_controls.text_3: Accelerate and steer the Train using movement keybinds
en_us.create.ponder.train_controls.text_4: If desired, the top speed can be fine-tuned using the mouse wheel
en_us.create.ponder.train_controls.text_5: Hold space to approach a nearby Station
en_us.create.ponder.train_controls.text_6: Trains can only be disassembled back into blocks at Stations
en_us.create.ponder.train_controls.text_7: Assembled Whistles can be activated with the sprint key
en_us.create.ponder.train_controls.text_8: Sneak or click again to stop controlling the Train
en_us.create.ponder.train_schedule.text_1: Schedules allow Trains to be controlled by other Drivers
en_us.create.ponder.train_schedule.text_2: Right-click with the item in hand to open its Interface
en_us.create.ponder.train_schedule.text_3: Once programmed, the Schedule can be handed off to a Train Driver
en_us.create.ponder.train_schedule.text_4: Any mob or blaze burner sitting in front of Train Controls is an eligible conductor
en_us.create.ponder.train_schedule.text_5: Creatures on a lead can be given their seat more conveniently
en_us.create.ponder.train_schedule.text_6: Schedules can be retrieved from Drivers at any moment
en_us.create.ponder.train_signal_placement.tex: Select a Train Track then place the Signal nearby
Signals control the flow of Trains not driven by players
Scheduled Trains will never cross signals in the opposite direction
...unless a second signal is added facing the opposite way.
Nixie tubes can be attached to make a signal's lights more visible
en_us.create.ponder.train_signal_redstone.head: Signals & Redstone
en_us.create.ponder.train_signal_redstone.text: Signals can be forced red by a redstone signal
Conversely, red signals emit a comparator output
en_us.create.ponder.train_signal_signaling.tex: Train Signals divide a track into segments
If a Segment is occupied, no other Trains will be allowed entry
Thus, each Segment will contain only one Train at a time
A second Signal mode is available via the Wrench
Segments of a brass signal usually lead into standard signals
This special Signal can stop trains under a second condition
It will stop Trains, which, upon entering...
...would not be able to leave the Segment immediately
This helps keeping queued Trains out of a busy Segment
en_us.create.ponder.valve_handle.text_1: Valve handles can be used to rotate components by a precise angle
en_us.create.ponder.valve_handle.text_2: The angle can be configured on the input panel
en_us.create.ponder.valve_handle.text_4: Sneak-Right-Click to activate it in the opposite direction
en_us.create.ponder.valve_handle.text_5: Mind that Bearings have to be specifically told not to disassemble
en_us.create.ponder.valve_handle.text_6: Valve handles can be dyed for aesthetic purposes
en_us.create.ponder.valve_pipe.text_1: Valve pipes help control fluids propagating through pipe networks
en_us.create.ponder.valve_pipe.text_2: Their shaft input controls whether fluid is currently allowed through
en_us.create.ponder.valve_pipe.text_3: Given Rotational Force in the opening direction, the valve will open up
en_us.create.ponder.valve_pipe.text_4: It can be closed again by reversing the input rotation
en_us.create.ponder.water_wheel.header: Generating Rotational Force using Water Wheels
en_us.create.ponder.water_wheel.text_1: Water Wheels draw force from adjacent Water Currents
en_us.create.ponder.water_wheel.text_2: Covering additional sides will not improve its kinetic output further
en_us.create.ponder.water_wheel.text_3: Use wood planks on the wheel to change its appearance
en_us.create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_1: Sneak and Right-Click holding an Ejector to select its target location
en_us.create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_10: It is now limited to this stack size, and only activates when its held stack reaches this amount
en_us.create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_11: Mobs and Players will always trigger an Ejector when stepping on it
en_us.create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_2: The placed ejector will now launch objects to the marked location
en_us.create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_3: A valid target can be at any height or distance within range
en_us.create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_4: They cannot however be off to a side
en_us.create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_5: If no valid Target was selected, it will simply target the block directly in front
en_us.create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_6: Supply Rotational Force in order to charge it up
en_us.create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_7: Items placed on the ejector cause it to trigger
en_us.create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_8: If Inventories are targeted, the ejector will wait until there is space
en_us.create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_9: Using the value panel, a required Stack Size can be configured
When powered by Redstone, Ejectors will not activate
Observers can detect when Ejectors activate
en_us.create.ponder.weighted_ejector_tunnel.he: Splitting item stacks using Weighted Ejectors
en_us.create.ponder.weighted_ejector_tunnel.te: Combined with Brass Tunnels, Ejectors can split item stacks by specific amounts
First, configure the Brass Tunnel to 'Prefer Nearest', in order to prioritize its side output
The Stack Size set on the Ejector now determines the amount to be split off
While a new stack of the configured size exits the side output...
...the remainder will continue on its path
en_us.create.ponder.windmill_source.header: Generating Rotational Force using Windmill Bearings
en_us.create.ponder.windmill_source.text_1: Windmill Bearings attach to the block in front of them
en_us.create.ponder.windmill_source.text_2: Create a movable structure with the help of Super Glue
en_us.create.ponder.windmill_source.text_3: If enough Sail-like blocks are included, this can act as a Windmill
en_us.create.ponder.windmill_source.text_4: Activated with Right-Click, the Windmill Bearing will start providing Rotational Force
en_us.create.ponder.windmill_source.text_5: The Amount of Sail Blocks determine its Rotation Speed
en_us.create.ponder.windmill_source.text_6: Use the value panel to configure its rotation direction
en_us.create.ponder.windmill_source.text_7: Right-click the Bearing anytime to stop and edit the Structure again
en_us.create.ponder.windmill_structure.text_1: Any Structure can count as a valid Windmill, as long as it contains at least 8 sail-like Blocks.
