en_us.item.create.attribute_filter.tooltip.sum: _Matches items_ against a set of _attributes_ or _categories_. Can be used in _Filter Slots_ of Create's Components
en_us.item.create.blaze_cake.tooltip.summary: A Delicious treat for your hard-working _Blaze Burners_. Gets them all fired up!
en_us.item.create.builders_tea.tooltip.summary: The perfect drink to get the day started- _Motivating_ and _Saturating._
en_us.item.create.cardboard_sword.tooltip.summ: Bonk. A _mostly_ _harmless_, yet powerful weapon of choice.
en_us.item.create.copper_backtank.tooltip.beha: Provides _Pressurized_ _Air_ to Equipment that requires it.
_Collects_ _Pressurized_ _Air_ at a rate depending on the Rotational Speed.
Wielder _descends_ more _quickly_ in liquids. Grants the ability to _walk_ and _jump_ underwater. Wielder also is no longer affected by _Mechanical_ _Belts_.
A pair of _heavy_ _boots_, allowing for better traversal of the Ocean floor.
en_us.item.create.copper_diving_helmet.tooltip: Provides the _Water Breathing_ effect, slowly draining _Air Pressure_ from the Backtank.
Together with a _Backtank_, allows the wielder to _breathe_ _underwater_ for an extended amount of time.
en_us.item.create.crafting_blueprint.behaviour: Opens a _Crafting_ _menu_ allowing you to _configure_ a _recipe_ and items to display.
_Applies_ the _configured_ _recipe_ with matching Ingredients found in your _Inventory_. _Sneak_ to craft up to a _Stack_ of items.
en_us.item.create.crafting_blueprint.tooltip.s: _Placed_ on a wall, it can be used to _specify_ _ingredient_ _arrangements_ for easier manual crafting. Each slot represents a Recipe.
A very special treat for your _Blaze Burners_. After eating this cake, Blaze Burners will _never run out of fuel_.
en_us.item.create.empty_schematic.tooltip.summ: Used as a recipe ingredient and for writing at the _Schematic Table_.
en_us.item.create.experience_nugget.tooltip.su: A speck of _inspiration_ from your fantastic inventions.
en_us.item.create.extendo_grip.tooltip.behavio: Increases _reach distance_ of items used in the _Main-Hand_.
_No_ _Durability_ will be used. Instead, _Air_ _pressure_ is drained from the Tank
en_us.item.create.extendo_grip.tooltip.summary: Greatly _increases reach distance_ of the wielder. Can be powered with _Air_ _Pressure_ from a _Backtank_
en_us.item.create.filter.tooltip.summary: _Matches items_ against a collection of _items_ or _other filters_. Can be used in _Filter Slots_ of Create's Components
en_us.item.create.goggles.tooltip.behaviour1: _Kinetic components_ show added _Stress Impact_ or _Capacity_. _Stressometers_ show statistics of their _attached kinetic network_. Some other blocks reveal information such as item and fluid content.
en_us.item.create.goggles.tooltip.summary: Augments your HUD with _miscellaneous information_ about placed components.
en_us.item.create.handheld_worldshaper.tooltip: _Targeted block_ will become the _material_ placed by the shaper.
Applies currently selected _Brush_ and _Tool_ at the targeted location.
_Creative mode_ tool for large-scale _landscaping_ from a distance.
en_us.item.create.linked_controller.tooltip.be: _Toggles_ the controller. _Movement_ _controls_ are taken over while its active.
Enables _Bind Mode_, press one of the _six controls_ to bind it to the _Links' Frequency_.
Places the Controller into the Lectern for easy activation. (R-Click while Sneaking to retrieve it)
en_us.item.create.linked_controller.tooltip.su: Grants _handheld_ _control_ over _Redstone Link_ frequencies assigned to its _six_ _buttons_.
en_us.item.create.minecart_coupling.tooltip.su: _Chains_ together individual _Minecarts_, causing them to move as a group.
en_us.item.create.netherite_backtank.tooltip.b: Provides _Pressurized_ _Air_ to Equipment that requires it.
_Collects_ _Pressurized_ _Air_ at a rate depending on the Rotational Speed.
en_us.item.create.netherite_diving_boots.toolt: Wielder _descends_ more _quickly_ in liquids. Grants the ability to _walk_ and _jump_ underwater. Wielder also is no longer affected by _Mechanical_ _Belts_.
A pair of _heavy_ _boots_, allowing for better traversal of the Ocean floor, including Oceans made of Lava.
en_us.item.create.netherite_diving_helmet.tool: Provides immunity to _Fire_ and _Lava_, slowly draining _Air Pressure_ from the Backtank. Also grants _improved vision_ in Lava
Together with a _Netherite Backtank_, this can protect you from _extreme heat_. To be effective, _Legs and Feet_ have to be covered in _Netherite_, too.
en_us.item.create.package_filter.tooltip.summa: _Matches packaged items_ by their targeted _address_. Can be used in _Filter Slots_ of Create's Components
en_us.item.create.potato_cannon.tooltip.behavi: _No_ _Durability_ will be used. Instead, _Air_ _pressure_ is drained from the Tank
en_us.item.create.potato_cannon.tooltip.summar: Launches your home-grown vegetables at Enemies. Can be powered with _Air_ _Pressure_ from a _Backtank_
en_us.item.create.sand_paper.tooltip.behaviour: Applies polish to items held in the _offhand_ or lying on the _floor_ when _looking at them_
en_us.item.create.sand_paper.tooltip.summary: Can be used to _refine materials_. The process can be automated with a Deployer.
en_us.item.create.schematic.tooltip.behaviour1: Can be positioned using the Tools on Screen.
en_us.item.create.schematic.tooltip.summary: Holds a structure to be positioned and placed into the world. Position the Hologram as desired and use a _Schematicannon_ to build it.
Select two _corner points_ using _R-Click_. Hold _Ctrl_ and Scroll to select locations mid-air.
_Ctrl-Scroll_ on the faces to adjust the size, then R-Click again to Save.
Used for _saving a Structure_ in your world to a _.nbt file_.
en_us.item.create.tree_fertilizer.tooltip.beha: Creates a tree _regardless_ of its _spacing conditions_

en_us.create_enchantment_industry.ponder.blaze: Automating with Mechanical Arms
In Extract Mode, two input Depots provide affixed equipment and a blank template
The input Arm recognizes each item's role for the selected mode and inserts it into the correct slot
Until both outputs are removed, neither the Arm nor a player can begin another batch
The output Arm extracts the stripped equipment and the filled template one after the other
Arms can also insert Apotheotic Essence containers and the Super activator; use a bottom pipe for continuous fluid supply
Introduction to Blaze Composer
The Blaze Composer transfers, combines, and reapplies Apotheosis affixes
Different affixes can also be collected together on the resulting template
Apply Mode consumes the template and adds or upgrades every compatible affix on the target equipment
Every output must be removed before the Composer will accept the next batch
Supply Apotheotic Essence through the bottom to activate Normal Mode
Normal Mode accepts Brass and Crystal Affix Templates; each tier has its own level capacity
Use the side panel to select Extract Mode...
...Merge Mode...
...or Apply Mode
Engineer's Goggles preview the required inputs, essence cost, result, and any reason an operation cannot start
Extract Mode moves one affix from equipment to a matching blank template and returns the equipment without that affix
Merge Mode combines templates of the same tier and rarity; two matching level 0.25 affixes produce level 0.5
Super Composing with Blaze Composer
Fill the Normal tank through the bottom pipe, then give the Composer a Godforged Pearl to permanently unlock its second tank
Keep the bottom pipe supplied after the unlock; once the Normal tank is full, more Apotheotic Essence flows into the second tank and activates Super Mode
Super Mode accepts only Apotheotic Affix Templates, which can carry levels beyond an affix's native limit
Actual level limits and essence costs follow server configuration; check them with Engineer's Goggles
With a clear path to the sky, an exposed nearby Lightning Rod safely redirects the strike with no penalty
Blocking the strike path prevents lightning, but the result randomly loses affix levels; Goggles show the possible loss range
With a clear sky but no Lightning Rod, the strike destroys the Composer before it can finish
Automating with Mechanical Arm
Blaze Enchanter can be automated with Mechanical Arm
Mechanical Arm can insert item for enchanting
Mechanical Arm also can feed experience fuel
Mechanical Arm can extract enchanted item and invalid item
Introduction to Blaze Enchanter
This is a Blaze Enchanter, which functions like an Enchanting Table
Because golden chest armor has better enchantability compared to diamond chest armor, it produces relatively better enchantments
However, higher Enchanting Level is not always better. Some enchantments will not appear when the Enchanting Level is too high!
Provide it Liquid Experience to activate it
Before enchanting with it, the enchant level must be set via the panel. The level cap of a vanilla enchanting table is 30
The panel is also a filter slot. Right click that slot with an item to designate that item as a template. This state is called Template Enchanting Mode
In Template Enchanting Mode, Blaze Enchanter can enchant Enchanting Template
Template Enchanting Mode is used to produce only enchantments supported by the template item
For example, placing diamond chest armor in the filter slot causes only diamond-chest-armor enchantments to be generated
Give a blank Enchanting Template to Blaze Enchanter, and the aforementioned enchantments will be added to it
Different materials and template item types will produce different enchantments
Super Enchanting with Blaze Enchanter
The Blaze Enchanter has two "stomachs". Feed it a Cake o' Enchanting...
...and it will begin seething. This state is known as Super Enchanting mode
The second tank of Blaze Enchanter can not be piped in for Liquid Experience. An eligible Super Experience item, such as Cake o' Enchanting, must be used
While in Super Enchanting mode, the enchant level cap is significantly increased. Additionally, the Enchanter can now produce Treasure Enchantments
Blaze Enchanter in Super Enchanting mode exclusively processes Super Enchanting Templates
Make sure to place a Lightning Rod nearby
Super Enchanting can cause lightning strikes
You can cover the Blaze Enchanter with block to avoid lightning strikes, but then curse may appear
If no Lightning Rods are present...
Automating with Mechanical Arm
Blaze Forger can be automated with Mechanical Arm
Mechanical Arm can insert item for forging
Mechanical Arm also can feed experience fuel
Mechanical Arm can extract forged item and invalid item
Introduction to Blaze Forger
This is a Blaze Forger, which functions like an Anvil
Provide it Liquid Experience to activate it
Blaze Forger can merge enchantments of the same item like an anvil, but with no Repair Cost
Blaze Forger can also merge Enchanting Templates
Work Mode can be changed via side panel
Switch Blaze Forger to Application Mode, and it can apply Enchanting Templates to items!
Switch it to Extract Mode, and it can strip an enchantment from equipment, books or templates into a blank Enchanting Template!
Super Enchanting with Blaze Forger
The Blaze Forger has two "stomachs". Feed it a Cake o' Enchanting...
...and it will begin seething, and enter Super Enchanting mode
The second tank of Blaze Forger can not be piped in for Liquid Experience. An eligible Super Experience item, such as Cake o' Enchanting, must be used
While in Super Enchanting mode, Blaze Forger can surpass the vanilla enchantment level cap while merging enchantments. Conflicting enchantments can also be merged together
Blaze Forger in Super Enchanting mode exclusively processes and applies Super Enchanting Templates
Make sure to place a Lightning Rod nearby
Super Enchanting can cause lightning strikes
You can cover the Blaze Forger with a block to avoid lightning strikes, but this may introduce Repair Cost
If no Lightning Rods are present...

en_us.create_enchantment_industry.ponder.exper: Things you might want to know
There are a few more things you need to know before you're ready to start using Enchantment Industry
Block of Experience is no longer purely decorative and storage block. You'll need it later
Block of Experience is required to make both the Enchantment Template and the Block of Super Experience
This is Block of Super Experience, used to make Super Enchanting Templates
Blaze Enchanter
Blaze Forger
Seething Blaze Forgers and Enchanters are in Super Enchanting mode
Super Enchanting allows you to surpass traditional enchanting limits
Specifically, this includes exceeding the vanilla enchantment level cap, merging conflicting enchantments, and obtaining treasure enchantments directly
As Beacon base block
Introduction to Experience Handling
This is a tank of Liquid Experience, the primary form of Experience used in Enchantment Industry
Use spout to refill Liquid Experience into a container item
Liquid Experience leaking from pipes will turn into Experience orbs
Converting the Experience you carry to liquid form requires two components
Liquid Hatch for accessing liquids directly from items
Experience Hatch for accessing experience directly from the player
But as part of Create, automation is a must, right?
Use Item Drain to pour Liquid Experience out of items
Mechanical Grindstone can also pulverize items. For example, it can convert Experience Nuggets into Liquid Experience
Crushing Wheel now has a new mechanism: It has a chance of dropping a very small amount of experience nugget when it kills a creature
Similarly, Deployer now drops Experience Nuggets after killing a creature
Prepare materials for Super Enchanting
First, obtain a Block of Super Experience, which will be used to make the Super Enchanting Template. This requires Block of Experience
Next, place a Lightning Rod
Lighting Strike!
The vast majority of lightning strikes only have a certain probability of transforming Block of Experience, and only lightning strikes caused by Super Enchanting are guaranteed to transform
Second, obtain Cake o' Enchanting. It works as "Super Experience" and causes Blazes to enter Super Enchanting mode.
If Cake o' Enchanting is used to put Blaze into Super Enchanting mode, what is Block of Super Experience used for?
Answer: Crafting Super Enchanting Template
In Super Enchanting mode, Blaze Forgers and Enchanters will not accept any normal Enchanting Templates and must use the Super Enchanting Template
Introduction to Experience Hatch
The Experience Hatch is simple to use. Right click it to store Experience...
...Shift-Right-Click Hatch to extract stored Experience
There are a filter slot and a scroll panel on Hatch. You can configure how much Experience is retrieved or deposited per interaction on the panel
The filter slot is used to deal with experience fluids of other mods
For example, assume that Liquid Cyan Dye is experience fluid from another mod
Place Bucket of Cyan Dye in the filter slot
You can now directly insert and extract Cyan Dye as "Cyan Experience"
Introduction to Experience Lantern
Experience Lantern absorbs experience from nearby players and experience orb. It glows according to the amount of experience stored internally

en_us.description.mekanism.antiprotonic_nucleo: A machine which uses bits of antimatter and mass amounts of energy to atomically transmute various resources.
en_us.description.mekanism.attack_amplificatio: Amplifies melee attacks on players or mobs.
en_us.description.mekanism.bin: A block used to store large quantities of a single type of item.
en_us.description.mekanism.blasting_unit: Uses controlled explosions to destroy nearby blocks in the target plane.
en_us.description.mekanism.boiler_casing: A pressure-resistant, dense casing used in the creation of a Thermoelectric Boiler multiblock.
en_us.description.mekanism.boiler_valve: A valve that can be placed on a Thermoelectric Boiler multiblock, allowing for the insertion of energy and water along with the extraction of produced steam.
en_us.description.mekanism.cable: A simple way of distributing energy throughout a transmitter network.
en_us.description.mekanism.charge_distribution: Evenly distributes charge throughout all worn MekaSuit armor.
en_us.description.mekanism.chargepad: A universal chargepad that can charge any energized item from any mod.
en_us.description.mekanism.chemical_crystalliz: An ultimate machine used to crystallize purified ore slurry into ore crystals.
en_us.description.mekanism.chemical_dissolutio: An ultimate machine used to chemically dissolve all impurities of an ore, leaving an unprocessed slurry behind.
en_us.description.mekanism.chemical_infuser: A machine that produces a new chemicals by infusing two others.
en_us.description.mekanism.chemical_injection_: An elite machine capable of processing ores into four shards, serving as the initial stage of 400% ore processing.
en_us.description.mekanism.chemical_oxidizer: A machine capable of oxidizing solid materials into gas phase.
en_us.description.mekanism.chemical_tank: A portable tank that lets you carry chemicals wherever you please.
en_us.description.mekanism.chemical_washer: An ultimate machine that cleans unprocessed slurry and prepares it for crystallization.
en_us.description.mekanism.color_modulation_un: Uses advanced holographic projectors to modulate the perceived color of the MekaSuit.
en_us.description.mekanism.combiner: A machine used to combine items together. For example, raw ores and cobblestone to form their ore counterparts.
en_us.description.mekanism.conductor: A simple way of transferring heat from one location to another.
en_us.description.mekanism.crusher: A machine used to crush ingots into their dust counterparts, as well as perform many other operations.
en_us.description.mekanism.dictionary: A tool used for viewing the tags of various components such as: items, blocks, and fluids.
en_us.description.mekanism.digital_miner: A highly-advanced, filter-based, auto-miner that can mine whatever block you tell it to within a 32 block (max) radius.
en_us.description.mekanism.dimensional_stabili: A machine that prevents areas of the world from disappearing when not observed.
en_us.description.mekanism.dosimeter_unit: Displays the user's current radiation dose in the HUD.
en_us.description.mekanism.dynamic_tank: The casing used in the Dynamic Tank multiblock, a structure capable of storing great amounts of fluid and chemicals.
en_us.description.mekanism.dynamic_valve: A valve that can be placed on a Dynamic Tank multiblock, allowing for fluids and chemicals to be inserted and extracted via external piping.
en_us.description.mekanism.electric_pump: An advanced, upgradeable pump, capable of extracting any type of fluid.
en_us.description.mekanism.electrolytic_breath: Uses electrolysis to create breathable oxygen from water. Will also fill a jetpack module with hydrogen when necessary.
en_us.description.mekanism.electrolytic_separa: A machine that uses the process of electrolysis to split apart a certain fluid into two different chemicals.
en_us.description.mekanism.elytra_unit: Applies an HDPE Reinforced Elytra to the MekaSuit.
en_us.description.mekanism.energized_smelter: A simple machine that serves as a Mekanism-based furnace that runs off of energy.
en_us.description.mekanism.energy_cube: An advanced device for storing and distributing energy.
en_us.description.mekanism.enrichment_chamber: A simple machine used to enrich ores into two of their dust counterparts, as well as perform many other operations.
en_us.description.mekanism.excavation_escalati: Increases digging speed on any block.
en_us.description.mekanism.factory: A machine that serves as an upgrade to regular machinery, allowing for multiple processing operations to occur at once.
en_us.description.mekanism.farming_unit: Allows for soil tilling, log stripping, and soil flattening.
en_us.description.mekanism.fluid_tank: A handy, sturdy, portable tank that lets you carry multiple buckets of fluid wherever you please. Also doubles as a bucket!
en_us.description.mekanism.fluidic_plenisher: A machine that is capable of creating entire lakes by filling ravines with fluids.
en_us.description.mekanism.fluorite_ore: A mineral found relatively deep under the world's surface. The crystals can be processed into Hydrofluoric Acid, an essential chemical for Uranium processing.
en_us.description.mekanism.formulaic_assemblic: A machine that uses energy to rapidly craft items and blocks from Crafting Formulas. Doubles as an advanced crafting bench.
en_us.description.mekanism.frost_walker_unit: Uses liquid hydrogen to freeze any water the player walks on. Install multiple for a greater range.
en_us.description.mekanism.fuelwood_heater: A machine that is capable of producing large quantities of heat energy by burning combustible items.
en_us.description.mekanism.geiger_unit: Displays the ambient radiation level in the HUD.
en_us.description.mekanism.gravitational_modul: Using experimental technologies and the tremendous energy of antimatter, allows the user to defy gravity.
en_us.description.mekanism.gyroscopic_stabiliz: Allows the user to act as though they are on solid ground.
en_us.description.mekanism.hydraulic_propulsio: Allows the user to both step and jump higher.
en_us.description.mekanism.hydrostatic_repulso: Uses advanced technology to repel water, lowering the resistance felt while moving through it.
en_us.description.mekanism.induction_casing: A type of energy-resistant casing used in the creation of an Energized Induction Matrix multiblock.
en_us.description.mekanism.induction_cell: A highly conductive energy capacitor capable of storing massive amounts of energy in a single block. Housed in an Energized Induction Matrix to expand the multiblock's energy storage.
en_us.description.mekanism.induction_port: A port that can be placed on an Energized Induction Matrix multiblock, allowing for energy to be inserted from and output to external cabling.
en_us.description.mekanism.induction_provider: An advanced complex of coolant systems, conductors and transformers capable of expanding the Energized Induction Matrix's maximum rate of energy transfer.
en_us.description.mekanism.industrial_alarm: Not just your everyday alarm... this is an 'industrial' alarm!
en_us.description.mekanism.inhalation_purifica: Applies a miniature electromagnetic field around the breathing apparatus, preventing selected potion effect types.
en_us.description.mekanism.isotopic_centrifuge: A machine with one single purpose: to spin its contents really, REALLY fast.
en_us.description.mekanism.jetpack_unit: Applies a hydrogen-fueled jetpack to the MekaSuit.
en_us.description.mekanism.laser: An advanced form of linear energy transfer that utilizes an extremely collimated beam of light.
en_us.description.mekanism.laser_amplifier: A block that can be used to merge, redirect and amplify laser beams, with fine controls over when to fire.
en_us.description.mekanism.laser_dissipation_u: Refracts and safely dissipates lasers that hit any MekaSuit armor piece.
en_us.description.mekanism.laser_tractor_beam: A block used to merge and redirect laser beams. Collects drops from blocks it has broken.
en_us.description.mekanism.lead_ore: A somewhat rare metal that is excellent at resisting radioactive particles.
en_us.description.mekanism.locomotive_boosting: Increases the user's sprinting speed (and jumping distance).
en_us.description.mekanism.logistical_sorter: A filter-based, advanced sorting machine that can auto-eject specified items out of and into adjacent inventories and Logistical Transporters.
en_us.description.mekanism.magnetic_attraction: Uses powerful magnets to draw distant items towards the player. Install multiple for a greater range.
en_us.description.mekanism.metallurgic_infuser: A machine used to infuse various materials into (generally) metals to create metal alloys and other compounds.
en_us.description.mekanism.modification_statio: An advanced workbench capable of installing and removing modules from modular equipment (i.e. MekaSuit!)
en_us.description.mekanism.motorized_servo_uni: Uses motorized servos to reduce the strain of sneaking.
en_us.description.mekanism.nutritional_injecti: Automatically feeds the player Nutritional Paste when hungry.
en_us.description.mekanism.nutritional_liquifi: A machine that is capable of processing any foods into non-dangerous, easily-digestible Nutritional Paste.
en_us.description.mekanism.oredictionificator: A machine used to unify and translate between various items and blocks using item tags.
en_us.description.mekanism.osmium_compressor: A fairly advanced machine used to compress osmium into various dusts in order to create their ingot counterparts.
en_us.description.mekanism.osmium_ore: A strong mineral that can be found at nearly any height in the world. It is known to have many uses in the construction of machinery.
en_us.description.mekanism.painting_machine: A machine used to color blocks and items via a careful application of a stored pigment.
en_us.description.mekanism.personal_barrel: A 54-slot barrel that can be opened anywhere- even from your own inventory.
en_us.description.mekanism.personal_chest: A 54-slot chest that can be opened from your own inventory.
en_us.description.mekanism.pigment_extractor: A machine used to extract pigments from blocks and items.
en_us.description.mekanism.pigment_mixer: A sturdy machine capable of mixing two pigments together to produce a new pigment.
en_us.description.mekanism.pipe: A simple way of distributing fluids throughout a transmitter network.
en_us.description.mekanism.precision_sawmill: A machine used to process logs and other wood-based items more efficiently, as well as to obtain sawdust.
en_us.description.mekanism.pressure_disperser: A block used to disperse steam throughout a multiblock structure. These should form a gapless, horizontal plane in order to properly control steam flow.
en_us.description.mekanism.pressurized_reactio: An advanced machine that processes a solid, liquid and chemical mixture and creates both a chemical and solid product.
en_us.description.mekanism.purification_chambe: An advanced machine capable of processing ores into three clumps, serving as the initial stage of 300% ore processing.
en_us.description.mekanism.qio_dashboard: A placeable monitor used to access an Quantum Item Orchestration system's contents.
en_us.description.mekanism.qio_drive_array: The foundation of any Quantum Item Orchestration system. QIO Drives are stored here.
en_us.description.mekanism.qio_exporter: A QIO-linked item export unit. Place on a block and export contents from your QIO system to the block.
en_us.description.mekanism.qio_importer: A QIO-linked item import unit. Place on a block and import its contents to your QIO system.
en_us.description.mekanism.qio_redstone_adapte: A QIO-linked redstone adapter. Use to monitor your QIO system's contents.
en_us.description.mekanism.quantum_entanglopor: A highly-advanced block capable of transmitting any practical resource across long distances and dimensions.
en_us.description.mekanism.radiation_shielding: Provides thick, radiation-proof metal plating to any MekaSuit armor piece.
en_us.description.mekanism.radioactive_waste_b: A barrel that can be used to 'safely' store radioactive waste. WARNING: breaking this barrel will release its contents into the atmosphere.
en_us.description.mekanism.resistive_heater: A condensed, coiled resistor capable of converting electrical energy directly into heat energy.
en_us.description.mekanism.restrictive: - Only used if no other paths available
en_us.description.mekanism.rotary_condensentra: A machine capable of converting chemicals into their fluid form and vice versa.
en_us.description.mekanism.security_desk: A central control hub for managing the security of all your owned machinery.
en_us.description.mekanism.seismic_reader: A portable machine that uses seismic vibrations to provide information on differing layers of the world.
en_us.description.mekanism.seismic_vibrator: A machine that uses seismic vibrations to provide information on differing layers of the world.
en_us.description.mekanism.shearing_unit: Allows the creation of energy blades for precise cutting jobs. Does not add laser swords.

en_us.configuration.mekanismgenerators.gear.me: Geothermal charging rate in Joules per tick, per degree above ambient, per upgrade installed. This value scales down based on how much of the MekaSuit Pants is submerged. Fire is treated as having a temperature of ~200K above ambient, lava has a temperature of 1,000K above ambient.
Percent of heat damage negated by MekaSuit Pants with maximum geothermal generator units installed. This number scales down linearly based on how many units are actually installed.
Amount of fuel (mB) that each assembly contributes to the fuel and waste capacity. Max = fuelAssemblies * maxFuelPerAssembly
The burn rate increase each fuel assembly provides. Max Burn Rate = fuelAssemblies * burnPerAssembly
The default burn rate of the fission reactor.
The heat capacity added to a Fission Reactor by a single casing block. Increase to require more energy to raise the reactor temperature.
Amount of cooled coolant (mB) that each block of the fission reactor contributes to the volume. Max = volume * cooledCoolantPerTank
Amount of heated coolant (mB) that each block of the fission reactor contributes to the volume. Max = volume * heatedCoolantPerTank
The percentage of waste in a fission reactor's output waste tank that is necessary to trigger the excess waste.
Amount of energy created (in heat) from each whole mB of fission fuel.
The chance of a catastrophic meltdown occurring once the reactor's damage passes 100%. This will linearly scale as damage continues increasing passed 100%.
Percent damage that a reactor will start at after being reconstructed after a meltdown.

Whether catastrophic meltdowns can occur from Fission Reactors. If this is disabled, instead of melting down the reactor will force turn itself off and not be able to be turned back on until the damage level has returned to safe levels.
How much radioactivity of fuel/waste contents are multiplied during a meltdown.
The radius of the explosion that occurs from a meltdown.
Settings for configuring Fission Reactor Meltdowns.
The average surface area of a Fission Reactor's fuel assemblies to reach 100% boil efficiency. Higher values make it harder to cool the reactor.
Amount of energy (Joules) the fusion reactor can store.
Amount of fuel (mB) that the fusion reactor can store.
The fraction of heat from the casing that can be transferred to all sources that are not water. Will impact max heat, heat transfer to thermodynamic conductors, and power generation.
Affects the Injection Rate, Max Temp, and Ignition Temp.
Amount of steam (mB) per injection rate that the fusion reactor can store. Max = injectionRate * steamPerInjection
Amount of water (mB) per injection rate that the fusion reactor can store. Max = injectionRate * waterPerInjection
The fraction of the heat dissipated from the case that is converted to Joules.
The fraction of the heat from the casing that is dissipated to water when water cooling is in use. Will impact max heat, and steam generation.
Energy produced by the Bio Generator in Joules/t.
The capacity in mB of the fluid tank in the Bio Generator.
The capacity in mB of the chemical tank in the Gas-Burning Generator.
The amount of lava in mB that gets consumed to transfer heatGeneration Joules to the Heat Generator.
Multiplier of effectiveness of Lava that is adjacent to the Heat Generator.
Add this amount of Joules to the energy produced by a heat generator if it is in an 'ultrawarm' dimension, in vanilla this is just the Nether.

Amount of energy in Joules the Heat Generator produces per tick. heatGeneration + heatGenerationLava * lavaSides + heatGenerationNether. Note: lavaSides is how many sides are adjacent to lava, this includes the block itself if it is lava logged allowing for a max of 7 "sides".
The capacity in mB of the fluid tank in the Heat Generator.
Peak energy generation in Joules/t for the Advanced Solar Generator. Note: It can go higher than this value in some extreme environments.
Peak energy generation in Joules/t for the Solar Generator. Note: It can go higher than this value in some extreme environments.

The maximum Y value that affects the Wind Generators Power generation. This value gets clamped at the world's logical height. For example for worlds like the nether that are 256 blocks tall, but have a ceiling at 128 blocks, this would be clamped at 128.
Maximum energy generation in Joules/t that the Wind Generator can produce.
The minimum Y value that affects the Wind Generators Power generation. This value gets clamped at the world's minimum height.
Minimum energy generation in Joules/t that the Wind Generator can produce.
Rate in mB/t at which Hohlraum can accept D-T Fuel.
The number of Turbine Blades supported by each Electromagnetic Coil.
Amount of chemical (mB) that each block of the turbine's steam cavity contributes to the volume. Max = volume * chemicalPerTank
Amount of energy in Joules that each block of the turbine contributes to the total energy capacity. Max = volume * energyCapacityPerVolume
The rate in mB/t at which steam is condensed into water in the turbine.
The rate in mB/t at which steam is dispersed into the turbine.
The rate in mB/t at which steam is vented into the turbine.

en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.name: Mystical Agriculture
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.landing_text: Mystical Agriculture is a mod based around the concept of growing your resources. This book will be your guide to using all the features of Mystical Agriculture. $(br2)$(l:https://blakesmods.com/wiki/mysticalagriculture)Click here for more detailed guides.$()
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.category.basics: This section goes over the different things required to get started in Mystical Agriculture. $(br2)$(l:https://blakesmods.com/wiki/mysticalagriculture/guides/getting-started)Click here for a detailed Getting Started guide.$()
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.category.advanc: This section goes over some of the more advanced content that comes after you've gotten established.
This section goes over the Nether content as well as the mob soul content required for creating and using mob drop based crops. $(br2)$(l:https://blakesmods.com/wiki/mysticalagriculture/guides/collecting-mob-souls)Click here for a detailed guide on collecting Mob Souls.$()
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.category.elemen: This section goes over Awakened Supremium and other elemental essence based content. $(br2)$(l:https://blakesmods.com/wiki/mysticalagriculture/guides/awakened-supremium)Click here for a detailed guide on creating Awakened Supremium.$()
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.category.machin: This section goes over the different machine type blocks in Mystical Agriculture.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.category.tinker: This section goes over Essence Tools/Armor as well as the tinkering system. $(br2)$(l:https://blakesmods.com/wiki/mysticalagriculture/guides/upgrading-essence-gear)Click here for a detailed guide on upgrading Essence Tools/Armor.$()
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.category.augmen: This section goes over each of the Augments and what they do.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.inferium_: Inferium Essence is one of the two base materials in Mystical Agriculture. It's used in the creation of pretty much everything in the mod. You can $(bold)usually$() obtain Inferium Essence by killing hostile or passive mobs, mining it from the ground, or growing it.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.prosperit: Prosperity Shards are the other of the two base materials in Mystical Agriculture. They are used to create magical variations of basic materials. You can $(bold)usually$() obtain Prosperity Shards by mining them from the ground.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.infusion_: The Infusion Crystal is used to create higher tier essences.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.inferium_: Inferium Seeds are one of the main ways to collect Inferium Essence. They can be grown on any farmland, but are most efficient on $(l:basics/essence_farmland)Essence Farmland$().
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.overworld: Inferium Ore $(bold)usually$() spawns between Y level -32 and 64 in the Overworld.
Prosperity Ore $(bold)usually$() spawns between Y level -60 and 24 in the Overworld.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.resource_: Resource Crops are the heart and soul of what makes Mystical Agriculture so great. However, there are some special properties of resource crops that should be noted. $(br2)$(li)Resource Crops can not be grown using Bonemeal. $(li)Resource Crops do not drop a second seed unless planted on $(l:basics/essence_farmland)Essence Farmland$().
Resource Crops are $(bold)usually$() created using an $(l:basics/infusion_altar)Infusion Altar$().
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.essence_f: Essence Farmland increases the output efficiency of Mystical Agriculture crops in multiple ways. They are listed on the following page. $(br2)You can create Essence Farmland by either right-clicking on Farmland in-world with an essence or by crafting it.

$(li)Crops will $(bold)usually$() have a 10 percent chance to drop a second seed when planted on any tier Essence Farmland. $$(li)Crops will have an additional 10 percent chance to drop a second seed when planted on the corresponding tier Essence Farmland. $(li)Inferium Seeds will drop more essences when planted on higher tier Essence Farmland.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.growth_ac: Growth Accelerators are used to increase plant growth speed. They apply random growth ticks to the first plant placed above them within the specified range. $(br2)You can stack multiple Growth Accelerators of any tier as long as the plant is within range.

The range of the Growth Accelerator is based on it being placed underneath the farmland. $(br2)$(l:https://blakesmods.com/wiki/mysticalagriculture/guides/speeding-up-crop-growth)Click here for a detailed guide on using Growth Accelerators.$()
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.watering_: Watering Cans are used to accelerate crop growth using manual* labor. To fill one up, simply right click on a Water source block.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.infusion_: The Infusion Altar is a crafting structure that is $(bold)usually$() used to create Mystical Agriculture seeds. The structure consists of 1 Infusion Altar and 8 Infusion Pedestals. $(br2)Once you have a recipe put in place, you just need to activate the altar with a Wand or Redstone signal.

Placing the Infusion Altar in world will show you where to place your pedestals. $(br2)$(l:https://blakesmods.com/wiki/mysticalagriculture/guides/creating-seeds)Click here for a detailed guide on using the Infusion Altar.$()
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.fertilize: Fertilized Essence $(bold)usually$() drops from all $(l:basics/resource_crops)Resource Crops$() $(bold)except Inferium$(). It works identically to Bonemeal, but also works on $(l:basics/resource_crops)Resource Crops$()! $(br2)Fertilized Essence can also be used to more efficiently craft $(l:advances/mystical_fertilizer)Mystical Fertilizer$().
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.mystical_: Mystical Fertilizer is used to instantly grow a crop or sapling. It's effective on $(l:basics/resource_crops)Resource Crops$() too!
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.master_in: The Master Infusion Crystal has infinite durability. You want this, I know you do.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.essence_w: Upgrading the regular $(l:basics/watering_can)Watering Can$() with essences and $(l:advances/mystical_fertilizer)Mystical Fertilizer$() improves your farming experience a ton. $(br2)Upgraded Watering Cans have improved range and growth acceleration speed. You can also toggle automatic watering by Shift + Right Clicking with the Watering Can while not targeting a block.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.sickles.p: Sickles are used for harvesting/destroying large areas of plant material. $(br2)Higher tier Sickles will have a greater area of effect.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.scythes.p: Scythes are used for harvesting large areas of crops by right clicking. Any fully grown crops within the area of effect will be harvested without being uprooted. $(br2)Scythes are also an effective weapon with an increased attack AOE. $(br2)Higher tier Scythes have a greater area of effect.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.soulstone: Soulstone is a special kind of stone that spawns in the Nether. It generates in large veins at all Y levels. $(br2)Soulstone is a decorative block with many variants. It is also required to create $(l:souls/witherproof_blocks)Witherproof Blocks$().
It can also be smelted into Soul Dust, which has many uses as well.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.soulium_o: Soulium Ore $(bold)usually$() spawns inside $(l:souls/soulstone)Soulstone$() veins in the Nether.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.witherpro: Witherproof Blocks are unbreakable by the Wither. Very useful for those who like to cheese bosses. $(br2)They are also immune to damage from the Ender Dragon, however it can still fly though them.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.soulium_d: The Soulium Dagger is used to collect souls from mobs. These souls are collected using $(l:souls/soul_jars)Soul Jars$(). Souls are collected by killing mobs with the Soulium Dagger $(br2)The Soulium Dagger can be upgraded using an $(l:basics/infusion_altar)Infusion Altar$(), improving soul collection efficiency.
The Passive Attuned Soulium Dagger provides an additional +50 percent souls gathered from passive mobs.
The Hostile Attuned Soulium Dagger provides an additional +50 percent souls gathered from hostile mobs.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.soul_jars: Soul Jars are used in combination with a $(l:souls/soulium_dagger)Soulium Dagger$() to collect mob souls. Filled Soul Jars can be used to create $(l:basics/resource_crops)Resource Crops$() for the corresponding entity. $(br2)Soul Jars can also be filled using mob drops with a $(l:machines/soul_extractor)Soul Extractor$().
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.experienc: Experience Capsules are used to collect experience for creating Experience Seeds. $(br2)To collect experience, simply have some Experience Capsules in your inventory and pick up Experience Orbs.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.enchanter: The Enchanter is a block that allows you to enchant your tools and armor using different crafting materials and Experience Essence. $(br2)The Enchanter can apply enchantments to both Books and tools/armor, similarly to an Anvil.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.elemental: Air, Earth, Water and Fire essences can be used in $(l:elemental/awakening_altar)Awakening Altar$() recipes using $(l:elemental/essence_vessel)Essence Vessels$(). $(br2)Elemental seeds can be planted on $(l:basics/essence_farmland)Tier 1 Essence Farmland$() for additional drops.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.cognizant: Cognizant Dust is $(bold)usually$() obtained by killing a Wither or Ender Dragon using an $(l:tinkering/essence_tools)Essence Weapon$() enchanted with Mystical Enlightenment. $(br2)Higher levels of Mystical Enlightenment will increase the amount of dust dropped on kill.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.essence_v: Essence Vessels are used in the $(l:elemental/awakening_altar)Awakening Altar$() structure to hold the elemental essences required to create items. Each vessel can hold up to 40 of a single elemental essence.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.awakening: The Awakening Altar is a crafting structure that is $(bold)usually$() used to create $(l:elemental/awakened_supremium)Awakened Supremium$(). The structure consists of 1 Infusion Altar, 4 Infusion Pedestals and 4 $(l:elemental/essence_vessel)Essence Vessels$(). $(br2)Once you have a recipe put in place, you just need to activate the altar with a Redstone signal.
Placing the Awakening Altar in world will show you where to place your pedestals and vessels.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.awakened_: Awakened Supremium is a high level crafting material used to create upgraded versions of many of your Supremium items. $(br2)Awakened Supremium is $(bold)usually$() created by infusing $(l:elemental/cognizant_dust)Cognizant Dust$() with a Supremium Block using an $(l:elemental/awakening_altar)Awakening Altar$().
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.machine_u: Machine Upgrades can be placed in applicable machines to increase their effectiveness. $(br2)Higher tier machines will both use and generate power faster.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.essence_f: The basic furnace can be upgraded to take advantage of $(l:machines/machine_upgrades)Machine Upgrades$() for increased cooking speed. They run off of solid fuels and have an internal power storage buffer.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.seed_repr: Seed Reprocessors are used to convert your excess seeds into their respective essences. They run off of solid fuels and have an internal power storage buffer.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.soul_extr: Soul Extractors are used to convert mob drops into mob souls. They run off of solid fuels and have an internal power storage buffer. $(br2)The Soul Extractor provides a use for extra mob drops you may have, but generally won't be as efficient as using a $(l:souls/soulium_dagger)Soulium Dagger$().
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.harvester: Harvesters are used to automatically harvest fully grown crops. They run off of solid fuels and have an internal power storage buffer. $(br2)The harvester will automatically re-plant the crops it harvests. $(br2)The harvester will place all resources into it's internal inventory. If there's no space, the items will be placed on the crop.

The Harvester will use a bit of power every time it checks a crop for growth. Harvesting fully grown crops uses an increased amount of power. $(br2)These machines can upgraded with $(l:machines/machine_upgrades)Machine Upgrades$(). $(br2)The Harvester can be de-activated with a Redstone signal.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.soulium_s: The Soulium Spawner is used to spawn both hostile and passive mobs using Essences. They run off of solid fuels and have an internal power storage buffer. $(br2)The Spawner has an internal inventory that can hold up to 512 items. Each operation will take a certain amount of items and power to spawn a corresponding mob.

The Spawner will spawn the mob randomly in a 3 block radius around it. $(br2)These machines can upgraded with $(l:machines/machine_upgrades)Machine Upgrades$(). $(br2)The Soulium Spawner can be de-activated with a Redstone signal.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.essence_t: Upgrading your Diamond* tools with essence improves their durability and mining speed. This also allows them to be equipped with $(l:tinkering/augments)Augments$(). $(br2)Essence Tools can be repaired in an Anvil with their corresponding Essence Ingot. These tools each have 1 augment slot.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.essence_a: Upgrading your Diamond* armor with essence improves its durability and protection. This also allows them to be equipped with $(l:tinkering/augments)Augments$(). $(br2)Essence Armor can be repaired in an Anvil with their corresponding Essence Ingot. These armor pieces each have 1 augment slot.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.tinkering: The Tinkering Table is used to add $(l:tinkering/augments)Augments$() to $(l:tinkering/essence_tools)Essence Tools$() and $(l:tinkering/essence_armor)Essence Armor$().
Augments are upgrades for $(l:tinkering/essence_tools)Essence Tools$() and $(l:tinkering/essence_armor)Essence Armor$(). You add Augments to your gear using a $(l:tinkering/tinkering_table)Tinkering Table$(). $(br2)Each Augment has a tier assigned to it, designating the minimum tier of gear piece required to equip it.
You can see what each Augment does in the 'Augments' section of this guide.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.absorptio: The Absorption Augment is an armor augment that grants the user 2-10 Absorption hearts every 8 minutes while they have the armor equipped.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.health_bo: The Health Boost Augment is an armor augment that adds 2-10 hearts to the wearer while they have the armor equipped.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.night_vis: The Night Vision Augment is a helmet augment that grants the wearer Night Vision while they have the armor equipped.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.water_bre: The Water Breathing Augment is a helmet augment that grants the wearer Water Breathing while they have the armor equipped.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.pathing_a: The Pathing AOE Augment is a Shovel augment that increases the area that the Shovel creates Path blocks, up to 9x9. $(br2)The AOE is activated by sneaking while using the Shovel. $(br2)The center of the AOE can be changed by pressing CTRL + Arrow Keys.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.jump_boos: The Jump Boost Augment is a boots augment that increases the wearers jump height while they have the armor equipped.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.speed_aug: The Speed Augment is a leggings augment that increases the wearers movement speed while they have the armor equipped. This effect is also applied to flight speed.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.mining_ao: The Mining AOE Augment is a tool augment that increases the are that the tool breaks blocks, up to 9x9. $(br2)This effect can be negated by sneaking. $(br2)The center of the AOE can be changed by pressing CTRL + Arrow Keys.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.no_fall_d: The No Fall Damage Augment is a boots augment that negates all fall damage for the wearer while they have the armor equipped.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.tilling_a: The Tilling AOE Augment is a Hoe augment that increases the area that the Hoe creates Farmland blocks, up to 9x9. $(br2)The AOE is activated by sneaking while using the Hoe. $(br2)The center of the AOE can be changed by pressing CTRL + Arrow Keys.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.fire_resi: The Fire Resistance Augment is an armor augment that grants the wearer Fire Resistance while they have the armor equipped.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.step_assi: The Step Assist Augment is a leggings or boots augment that enables the wearer to walk up 1 block heights without jumping while they have the armor equipped. $(br2)This effect can be negated by holding down the Shift key.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.strength_: The Strength Augment is a sword augment that increases the amount of damage the sword deals by 5-20.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.attack_ao: The Attack AOE Augment is a sword augment that increases the attack radius of the sword by up to 6 blocks.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.poison_re: The Poison Resistance Augment is an armor augment that prevents the wearer from getting the poisoned while they have the armor equipped.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.mining_fa: The Mining Fatigue Resistance Augment is an armor augment that prevents the wearer from getting the Mining Fatigue effect while they have the armor equipped.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.wither_re: The Wither Resistance Augment is an armor augment that prevents the wearer from getting the Wither effect while they have the armor equipped.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.flight_au: The Flight Augment is a chestplate augment that gives the wearer creative flight while they have the armor equipped.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.blindness: The Blindness Resistance Augment is a helmet augment that prevents the wearer from getting the Blindness effect while they have the armor equipped.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.hunger_re: The Hunger Resistance Augment is a helmet augment that prevents the wearer from getting the Hunger effect while they have the armor equipped.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.nausea_re: The Nausea Resistance Augment is a helmet augment that prevents the wearer from getting the Nausea effect while they have the armor equipped.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.slowness_: The Slowness Resistance Augment is a leggings augment that prevents the wearer from getting the Slowness effect while they have the armor equipped.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.weakness_: The Weakness Resistance Augment is a chestplate augment that prevents the wearer from getting the Weakness effect while they have the armor equipped.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.luck_augm: The Luck Augment is an armor augment that improves loot drops from fishing or loot chests for the wearer while they have the armor equipped.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.haste_aug: The Haste Augment is a chestplate augment that increases the wearer's mining speed while they have the armor equipped.
en_us.book.mysticalagriculture.entry.slow_fall: The Slow Falling Augment is a leggings augment that prevents the wearer from getting the Slowness effect while they have the armor equipped. $(br2)This effect can be negated by holding down the Shift key.

en_us.ars_nouveau.enchanting_desc: Once you have acquired a jar of Source and an Enchanting Apparatus, you may begin enchanting items. For more information, see the section on the Enchanting Apparatus.
en_us.ars_nouveau.familiar.script: Used for obtaining familiars. Obtained from the Ritual of Binding.
en_us.ars_nouveau.familiar_desc.familiar_ameth: Reduces knockback taken by half and knocks back any attackers. Giving the golem an Amethyst Shard will grant 3 minutes of Shielding.
en_us.ars_nouveau.familiar_desc.familiar_bookw: A Bookwyrm will automatically pickup nearby items and exp orbs within 5 blocks of the player. Thrown items will not be picked up. Use of the familiar hotkey is recommended to turn the magnet on and off as needed. Obtained by performing the Ritual of Binding near a Bookwyrm.
en_us.ars_nouveau.familiar_desc.familiar_drygm: A Drygmy familiar will increase the damage of Earth spells by 2, and has a chance to increase the amount of looting when slaying enemies. Obtained by performing the Ritual of Binding near a Drygmy.
en_us.ars_nouveau.familiar_desc.familiar_starb: A Starbuncle familiar that will grant you Speed 2. Additionally, using a Golden Nugget on the starbuncle will consume it and grant the owner a short duration of Scrying for Gold Ore. Obtained by performing the Ritual of Binding near a Starbuncle.
en_us.ars_nouveau.familiar_desc.familiar_whirl: Whirlisprigs will reduce the cost of Elemental Earth glyphs by half, and grants bonus saturation when consuming food. Obtained by performing the Ritual of Binding near a Whirlisprig.
en_us.ars_nouveau.familiar_desc.familiar_wixie: Wixies will increase the duration of potions that you apply, and wixies will accept basic potion reagents in exchange for applying the tier 1 potion result. Additionally, the Wixie will apply harmful potions to enemies during combat. Obtained by performing the Ritual of Binding near a Wixie.
en_us.ars_nouveau.familiars_desc: Familiars may be summoned to provide passive buffs for spell casting, passive buffs, and more.
en_us.ars_nouveau.filter_icon_tooltip: Filters: Prevents the spell from resolving if the target does not match the filter.
en_us.ars_nouveau.fire_essence.tooltip: Can be used as a fuel source.
en_us.ars_nouveau.fishing_rod.invalid: Invalid Spell. Enchanter's Fishing Rod accept Effects and Augments only.
en_us.ars_nouveau.form_icon_tooltip: Forms: Appear at the start of the spell and determine how it is cast.
en_us.ars_nouveau.gauntlet.invalid: Invalid spell. Gauntlets accept Effects and Augments only.
en_us.ars_nouveau.getting_started_desc: An introduction to Ars Nouveau. It is recommended to follow each section in order.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_accelerate: Increases the speed of projectile spells.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_amplify: Additively increases the power of most spell effects. Can increase the harvest level of Break and increases the damage of spells.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_animate_blo: Animates a block to fight for you. The animated block will convert to a falling block when it dies. Costs a large amount of mana, but does not grant Summoning Sickness
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_aoe: Spells will affect a larger area around a targeted block.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_blink: Teleports the caster to a location. If an entity is hit and the caster is holding a Warp Scroll in the offhand, the entity will be warped to the location on the Warp Scroll. When used on Self, the caster blinks forward. Spell Turrets and Runes can warp entities using Warp Scrolls from adjacent inventories without consuming the scroll.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_bounce: Gives players the Bounce effect, causing them to bounce upwards upon falling. Amplification of Bounce will preserve additional forward facing motion per bounce.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_break: Breaks blocks of an average hardness. Can be amplified to increase the harvest level. Sensitive will simulate breaking blocks with Shears instead of a pickaxe.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_bubble: Captures mobs and entities it touches, causing them to float upwards. If the bubble has been alive for at least one tick, damaging the entity trapped in the bubble will cause it to pop, dealing bonus damage to the entity inside. Extend time and amplify can be used to increase the duration and damage of the bubble.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_burst: Resolves the spell in a spherical area around the target. Augment with Sensitive to target blocks instead of entities and Dampen to make an empty sphere. Augment with AOE to increase the radius.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_cold_snap: Causes wet, slowed, or freezing entities to take a burst of damage and erupt into falling ice. Falling ice will slow and damage nearby entities. Can also be used to erupt a block of ice instead. Falling blocks of ice can be manipulated with the Focus of Block Shaping. Entities afflicted with Freezing will be set to the maximum freeze level immediately.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_conjure_wat: Places water at a location or extinguishes entities on fire. If augmented with extend time, it will keep entities wet for a longer period of time.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_crush: Turns stone into gravel, and gravel into sand. Will also crush flowers into bonus dye. Need Sensitive to work on items. For full recipe support, see JEI. Will also harm entities and deals bonus damage to entities that are swimming.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_cut: Simulates using shears on entities and blocks, or damages non-shearable entities for a small amount. Amplify will simulate using an Axe instead of Shears. For simulating breaking with shears, see Break and Sensitive. Costs nothing.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_dampen: Decreases the power of most spells.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_decelerate: Decreases the speed of projectile spells.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_delay: Delays the resolution of effects placed to the right of this spell for a few moments. The delay may be increased with the Extend Time augment, or decreased with Duration Down.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_dispel: Removes any potion effects on the target. When used on a witch at half health, the witch will vanish in return for a Wixie shard. Will also dispel tamed summons back into their charm.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_duration_do: Reduces the duration of spells like potion effects, delay, redstone signal, and others.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_ender_inven: Opens your personal ender chest inventory from anywhere.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_evaporate: Deletes fluids in an area. Can be expanded with AOE.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_exchange: When used on blocks, exchanges the blocks in the players hotbar for the blocks hit as if they were mined with silk touch. Can be augmented with AOE, and Amplify is required for swapping blocks of higher hardness. When used on entities, the locations of the caster and the entity hit are swapped.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_explosion: Causes an explosion at the location. Amplify increases the damage and size by a small amount, while AOE will increase the size of the explosion by a large amount, but not damage.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_extend_time: Extends the time that spells last, including buffs, fangs, and summons
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_extract: Applies a silk-touch effect to Break and causes Explosion to not destroy blocks that drop. Cannot be combined with Fortune.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_fangs: Summons Evoker Fangs in the direction where the spell was targeted. Using fangs on your self will spawn them in an area around you.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_fell: Harvests entire trees, mushrooms, cactus, and other vegetation. Can be amplified with Amplify to break materials of higher hardness. AOE will increase the number of blocks that may be broken at one time.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_firework: Creates a firework at the location or entity. Amplify will add Firework Stars, while Extend Time will add additional flight time. If a firework exists in the casters inventory, the created firework will mimic the held one. Spell Turrets with Touch will create fireworks as if they were dispensed.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_flare: When used on an entity or block that is on fire or afflicted with Blasting, Cinders will explode around the target, dealing damage and creating Mage Fire nearby. Mage Fire cannot spread to blocks and is short lived. Entities with Blasting will immediately explode for extra strength.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_fortune: Increases the drop chance from mobs killed by Damage and blocks that are destroyed by Break. Cannot be combined with Extract.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_freeze: Freezes water or lava in a small area or slows a target for a short time. Freeze on Ice will turn it into Packed Ice, and Packed Ice into Blue Ice. Sensitive will turn water into Frosted Ice and will vanish after a short time.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_glide: Grants the Glide effect, allowing the wearer to fly as if they were wearing an Elytra.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_gravity: Causes blocks and entities to fall. When augmented with Extend Time, players will have their flight disabled and will obtain the Gravity effect. While afflicted with Gravity, entities will rapidly fall and take double falling damage.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_grow: Causes plants to accelerate in growth as if they were bonemealed.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_gust: Knocks a target or block away a short distance from the caster. Sensitive will stop this spell from launching blocks.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_harm: Damages a target. May be increased by Amplify, or applies the Poison debuff when using a Time augment. Note, multiple Harms without a delay will not apply due to invincibility on hit.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_harvest: When used on grown crops, this spell will obtain the fully grown product without destroying the plant.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_heal: Heals a small amount of health and consumes hunger from the caster. When used on Undead, the spell will deal an equal amount of magic damage.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_hex: Applies the Hex effect. Hex increases any damage taken by a small amount while the user is afflicted by poison, wither, fire, or when frozen. Additionally, Hex cuts the rate of Mana Regeneration and healing in half.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_ignite: Sets blocks and mobs on fire for a short time. Sensitive will summon Mage Fire, a shorter lived fire that will not spread or destroy blocks.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_infuse: Infuses a target with a potion or flask from your inventory. If augmented with AOE, a splash potion will spawn at the location. If augmented with Extend Time, a lingering potion will spawn at the location. Caster blocks may pull from adjacent Potion Jars to cast infuse.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_intangible: Causes blocks to temporarily turn into air. Can be modified with Amplify for blocks of higher hardness, AOE, Duration Down, and Extend Time.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_interact: Interacts with blocks or entities as it were a player. Useful for reaching levers, chests, or animals. Sensitive will use your off-hand item on the block or entity, Amplify will use left-click instead of right-click on blocks.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_invisibilit: Causes the target to turn invisible for a short time.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_launch: Launches an entity or block into the air. Can be used for large jumps, yeeting mobs in the sky or for scaling mountains! Sensitive will stop this spell from launching blocks.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_leap: Launches the target in the direction they are looking. Amplification will increase the distance moved.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_light: If cast on a block, a permanent light source is created. May be amplified up to Glowstone brightness, or Dampened for a lower light level. When cast on yourself, you will receive night vision. When cast on other entities or with Sensitive, they will receive Night Vision and Glowing. If Sensitive, Glowing will use the spell color. Particles can be configured from the Spell Style menu in the spellbook.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_lightning: Summons a lightning bolt at the location. Entities struck will be given the Shocked effect. Shocked causes all additional lightning damage to deal bonus damage, and increases the level of Shocked up to III. Lightning also deals bonus damage to entities that are wet or wearing RF powered items. Can be augmented with Amplify, Dampen, and Extend Time.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_linger: Creates a lingering field that applies spells on nearby entities for a short time. Applying Sensitive will make this spell target blocks instead. AOE will expand the effective range, Accelerate will cast spells faster, Dampen will ignore gravity, and Extend Time will increase the duration.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_name: Names an entity after the set Spell Name. Targeting a block will name nearby entities or name inventory blocks directly if possible. Targeting with Self will name the held offhand item. Can be overridden with a name tag in the hotbar.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_orbit: Summons three orbiting projectiles around the target that will cast a spell on any entities it may hit. Additional projectiles, their speed, radius, and duration may be augmented. Sensitive will cause Orbit to hit blocks.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_pantomime: Applies spells to the nearest block in your line of sight. Dampen will reduce the distance, Amplify will increase it. Sensitive will highlight the selected block.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_phantom_blo: Creates a temporary block that will disappear after a short time. Amplify will cause the block to be permanent. Dispelling this block will destroy it instantly. Casting on an entity will create blocks around them in the upwards direction.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_pickup: Picks up nearby items in a medium radius where this spell is activated. The range may be expanded with AOE.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_pierce: When applied to the Projectile spell, projectiles may continue through their path an additional time after hitting a mob or block. Causes certain effects to also target the block behind them, like Break. Combines with AOE to provide depth.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_place_block: Places blocks from the casters inventory. If cast by a player, this spell will place blocks from the hot bar first. Casting on an entity will place the blocks beneath the entity in the up direction. Sensitive causes the block to be placed in the caster's facing direction, two Sensitives will place it in the opposite direction.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_prestidigit: Places an invisible temporary block that emits particles. Amplify will make this block permanent. Particles can be configured from the Spell Style menu in the spellbook. Targeting an entity will emit particles centered on them instead.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_projectile: Summons a projectile that applies spell effects when this projectile hits a target or block. Sensitive will allow Projectiles to break plants or other materials that do not block motion.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_pull: Pulls the target closer to the caster. When used on blocks, they become falling blocks with motion towards the side of the block that was hit. Sensitive will stop this spell from pulling blocks.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_randomize: Randomize the behavior of some glyphs. If used with spells like Place Block and Exchange, it will randomize the block that is placed between the blocks in your hotbar.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_redstone_si: Places a temporary block of redstone with configurable power and duration. Augment with Sensitive to set the target block as a power source for itself and surrounding blocks. Dampen and Amplify will adjust the power from the base value of 10.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_rotate: Rotates a block or an entity clockwise. If augmented with sensitive it will change the axis of the block (if possible) or force the entity to turn their look. Dampen will rotate counter-clockwise.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_rune: Places a rune on the ground that will cast the spell on targets that touch the rune. Unlike runes placed by Runic Chalk, these runes are temporary and cannot be recharged. When using Item Pickup, items are deposited into adjacent inventories. Sensitive will cause the rune to use the Owner's inventory for pickup and usage instead. Players with Magic Find will be able to read spells inscribed on runes.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_sense_magic: Applies Magic Find to the target, causing magical mobs to glow within 75 blocks of them. Magic Find also reveals spells on Runes.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_sensitive: Causes forms to target blocks they normally cannot target. Projectile and Orbit will target grass, and Touch will target fluids and air. Changes targeting rules of certain effects.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_smelt: Smelts blocks and items in the world. AOE will increase the number of items and radius of blocks that can be smelted at once, while Amplify will allow Smelt to work on blocks of higher hardness, Sensitive will make it only smelt items and not blocks. Dampen will cause Smelt to use smoking recipes.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_snare: Stops entities from moving and jumping. Extend Time will increase the duration of this effect. Snaring a block created from the Focus of Block Shaping will cause it to attempt to place itself immediately.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_split: Causes multiple projectiles to be cast at once. Each projectile applies a set of effects.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_summon_deco: Summons a decoy of yourself. Upon summoning, the decoy will attract any nearby mobs to attack it.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_summon_stee: Summons a saddled horse that will vanish after a few minutes. AOE will increase the amount summoned, while Extend Time will increase the duration of the summon. Applies Summoning Sickness to the caster, and cannot be cast while afflicted by this Sickness.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_summon_unde: Summons a number of Skeleton allies that will attack nearby hostile enemies. These Skeletons will last a short time until they begin to take damage, but time may be extended with the Extend Time augment.  Additionally, their summoned weapons are changed using augments, use Amplify to give it a better sword, or Pierce to give it a bow.  Adding Split after the effect will add to the number of summoned skeletons.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_summon_vex: Summons three Vex allies that will attack nearby hostile enemies. These Vex will last a short time until they begin to take damage, but time may be extended with the Extend Time augment.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_summon_wolv: Summons two wolves that will fight with you. Extend Time will increase the amount of time on the summons. Applies Summoning Sickness to the caster, preventing other summoning magic.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_toss: Causes the caster to place an item from their inventory to a location. If this glyph is used on an inventory, the item will attempt to be inserted into it. Toss throws 64 items by default. Dampen will halve the amount each time. Amplify will double the amount each time. Randomize will select a random stack.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_touch: Applies spells at the block or entity that is targeted.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_underfoot: Targets the spell on the block beneath the player.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_wall: Creates a lingering wall that applies spells on nearby entities for a short time. Applying Sensitive will make this spell target blocks instead. AOE will expand the effective range, Accelerate will cast spells faster, Dampen will ignore gravity, and Extend Time will increase the duration.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_wind_burst: Activates a wind charge at the target location, knocking entities back. Sensitive will allow the caster to ignore the knockback.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_wind_shear: Deals damage to targets in the air, with an increasing amount based on how high the target is off the ground, up to 10 blocks. Targets on the ground take no damage.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.reset: Resets the spell chain to the original target if it was changed by a previous effect. For example, Burst -> Place Block -> Reset -> Break will cause Burst to place blocks, but only Break will apply to the original location. As a result, using Reset will allow you to bypass combination and duplicate limits on glyphs.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.rewind: Rewinds an entity back in time to its previous locations and health. Can revert blocks that were moved with spells back into solid blocks. Glyphs that come after Rewind will be cast at the end of the rewind, as if they were Delayed.
en_us.ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.wololo: Changes the color of an entity or compatible block to the color of the spell.
en_us.ars_nouveau.gui.discord: Join the Discord for spells, updates, and support!
en_us.ars_nouveau.imbuement.crafting_started: Crafting %s. Add source nearby to increase craft speed.
en_us.ars_nouveau.imbuement.norecipe: No recipe found. If pedestals are required, they must be placed within the 1 block cube around the chamber.
en_us.ars_nouveau.imbuement.use_apparatus: Did you mean to use an Enchanting Apparatus for this recipe?
en_us.ars_nouveau.item_detector.connected: Detecting items at x: %s y: %s z: %s
en_us.ars_nouveau.jar_spawn_out_of_bounds: Cannot set jar spawn point out of bounds.
en_us.ars_nouveau.lectern_blacklist: This block has been disabled from being connected to the Storage Lectern.
en_us.ars_nouveau.lectern_out_of_range: The lectern is out of range.
en_us.ars_nouveau.light_message: Ars Nouveau adds built in dynamic lights. Enable with `/ars-light on`. This won't appear again!
en_us.ars_nouveau.lights_off: You have turned dynamic lights off.
en_us.ars_nouveau.lights_on: You have turned dynamic lights on. This can cause lag for users with weaker CPUs, low RAM allocation, and unexpected results with 'performance' mods like Optifine. Run this command or change the ars_nouveau-client config to disable this.
en_us.ars_nouveau.lily: Patrons may summon Lily, a faithful tail wagging companion.
en_us.ars_nouveau.manipulation_essence.tooltip: Can be scribed onto a Spell Parchment or caster tool to permanently hide the spell.
en_us.ars_nouveau.melder.destination_invalid: Destination cannot accept the mixed potion.
en_us.ars_nouveau.melder.from_capped: Melders can only meld two jars. Clear the melder by using the Dominion Wand while sneaking to remove all jars.
en_us.ars_nouveau.melder.no_to_pos: Wand the Melder to your desired Potion Jar.
en_us.ars_nouveau.melder.output_duplicate_effe: Cannot mix potions with the same effect but different levels.
en_us.ars_nouveau.melder.output_not_unique: Output potion is not a unique mix.
en_us.ars_nouveau.melder.to_set: Melder will send combined potions to this jar.
en_us.ars_nouveau.mirror.invalid: Invalid spell. Mirrors accept Effects and Augments only.
en_us.ars_nouveau.nook: Patrons may summon Nook, a faithfulish tail wagging companion.
en_us.ars_nouveau.not_enough_exp: Not enough EXP for this glyph.
en_us.ars_nouveau.page.agronomic_sourcelink: The Agronomic Sourcelink generates source from crop and tree growth within 15 blocks. Bonus source is generated for magical plants such as Mageblooms, Source Berry Bushes, and Archwood Saplings. Source will be output from the Sourcelink to nearby jars within 5 blocks. Note: Bonemealing crops will not grant Source.
en_us.ars_nouveau.page.alchemical_sourcelink: Generates source by consuming potions from adjacent potion jars. The amount of source varies per potion and is dependent on the complexity of the potion. Bonus source is given for the length and level of the potion with multipliers for each effect a potion contains. Utilizing Wixies and Potion Melders is recommended for creating highly complex potions.
en_us.ars_nouveau.page.alchemists_crown: Allows the wearer to consume potions and flasks instantly from their inventory.
en_us.ars_nouveau.page.amplify_arrow: Adds two amplifies to the end of the inscribed spell when used. Each recipe makes 32.
en_us.ars_nouveau.page.amulet_of_mana_boost: Increases max mana by a moderate amount.
en_us.ars_nouveau.page.amulet_of_mana_regen: Increases mana regeneration by a moderate amount.
en_us.ars_nouveau.page.annotated_codex: The Annoted Codex allows players to share their knowledge of glyphs with other players. To record your known glyphs, simply use the codex. Recording glyphs requires EXP for each glyph known, and the EXP will be consumed upon using the item. Using the item again will update the list of known glyphs. Other players may use the book to learn the glyphs, consuming the codex in the process.
en_us.ars_nouveau.page.bastion_fruit: A fruit that can be brewed into a Potion of Defence, reducing the amount of damage taken.
en_us.ars_nouveau.page.belt_of_levitation: A belt that allows the user levitate a moderate distance above the ground. Useful for climbing mountains! Simply sneak in the air while falling (or jumping) to rise. Reduces a small amount of fall damage while worn.
en_us.ars_nouveau.page.belt_of_unstable_gifts: Occasionally grants a random positive potion effect for a short duration. These effects can vary in strength.
en_us.ars_nouveau.page.bombegrante: A fruit that packs an explosive punch. Can be brewed into a Potion of Blasting, causing the target to explode when the duration ends.
en_us.ars_nouveau.page.brazier_relay: Allows the users to bind a Ritual Brazier ritual to a new location. Multiple rituals can be connected to the same brazier relay. To connect, use the Dominion Wand on your Ritual Brazier, then the relay. Source is consumed at the original braziers location. Can be bound within 15 blocks.
en_us.ars_nouveau.page.crystallizer1: The crystallizer provides a renewable source of Source Gems by condensing source over time.
